	if tileCanvas then
		pcall(function() tileCanvas.model.Parent = nil end)
	end
end

-- Reparent throws if the instance was Destroy()ed externally (other engine's
-- _PartIcleEmit sweep, Explorer delete): drop the ref so ensureCanvas rebuilds
-- instead of wedging applyFrame with a per-frame Parent-locked error.
local function unparkCanvas()
	if meshCanvas and not meshCanvas.part.Parent then
		local ok = pcall(function() meshCanvas.part.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent() end)
		if not ok then
			pcall(function() meshCanvas.em:Destroy() end)
			meshCanvas = nil
		end
	end
	if tileCanvas and not tileCanvas.model.Parent then
		local ok = pcall(function() tileCanvas.model.Parent = VisualHost.getCanvasParent() end)
		if not ok then
			tileCanvas = nil
		end
	end
end

function Canvas.applyFrame()
	local hadWork = cursor > 0
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		cursor = 0
		return
	end
	if not hadWork then
		-- Idle: keep the parked countdown honest and the plane camera-locked
		-- (a frozen world-space pane reads as a stale glass sheet) with the
		-- field zeroed exactly once.
		local live = (meshCanvas and meshCanvas.part.Parent) or (tileCanvas and tileCanvas.model.Parent)
		if live then
			if meshCanvas then ensureCamWeld(cam) end
			if idleSince == nil then
				idleSince = os.clock()
				if meshCanvas then applyMesh(cam, 1) else applyTiles(cam) end
				setDimmed(true)
			elseif os.clock() - idleSince >= IDLE_PARK_SECONDS then
				parkCanvas()
			else
				if meshCanvas then
					meshCanvas.part.CFrame = cam.CFrame * MESH_OFFSET
					meshCanvas.part:SetAttribute("_hb", os.clock())
				elseif tileCanvas then
					applyTiles(cam)
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end
	idleSince = nil
	-- Dormancy retries: when the foreign owner is gone (torn down, or parked
	-- forever and thus invisible), this engine reclaims the screen instead of
	-- staying silent for the session.
	if dormant then
		if foreignCanvasLive() then
			cursor = 0
			return
		end
		dormant = false
	end
	-- Wake ownership re-check: a parked (nil-Parent) canvas is invisible to the
	-- other engine's foreignCanvasLive probe, so a foreign canvas may have gone
	-- live during our idle window. First-claimant-wins: yield while it lives.
	local parked = (meshCanvas and not meshCanvas.part.Parent)
		or (tileCanvas and not tileCanvas.model.Parent)
	if parked and foreignCanvasLive() then
		goDormant()
		cursor = 0
		return
	end
	unparkCanvas()
	-- Highest active resolution request wins the shared plane.
	local targetRes = PlaneBuilder.RES_W
	for i = 1, cursor do
		if cRes[i] > targetRes then targetRes = cRes[i] end
	end
	ensureCanvas(targetRes)
	-- `building` alone does not bail: during a resolution upgrade the old plane
	-- keeps rendering until the swap.
	if dormant or (not meshCanvas and not tileCanvas) then
		cursor = 0
		return
	end
	if meshCanvas and not building and meshCanvas.resW < targetRes then
		upgradeMesh(targetRes)
	end
	local wantT = resolveTransparency()
	-- Every contribution faded to 1: keep vertices/CFrame live but dim the pane
	-- (Glass at T=1 still sheens  -  the idle quirk applies mid-life too).
	setDimmed(wantT >= 0.999 and wantT <= 1)
	if meshCanvas then
		ensureCamWeld(cam)
		applyMesh(cam, wantT)
	else
		applyTiles(cam)
	end
	cursor = 0
end

-- Engine teardown: destroy everything, clear the sticky probe so the next
-- Activate re-probes (permissions can change between sessions).
function Canvas.reset()
	dropCamWeld()
	if meshCanvas then
		pcall(function() meshCanvas.part:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() meshCanvas.em:Destroy() end)
		meshCanvas = nil
	end
	if tileCanvas then
		pcall(function() tileCanvas.model:Destroy() end)
		tileCanvas = nil
	end
	cursor = 0
	building = false
	buildGen += 1
	meshTierAvailable = nil
	overdriveLatched = false
	idleSince = nil
	dimmed = false
	dormant = false
	dormantWarned = false
	overflowWarned = false
end

return Canvas

--[[
	Distortion/Field  -  pure height-field math for the screen-distortion canvas.
	NO Roblox APIs (fengari-testable): plain arrays + numbers in, numbers out.

	Contract: every add* function ACCUMULATES amp-scaled height into `height[]`
	(linearity is the Canvas compositor contract  -  concurrent effects sum).
	Coordinates: baseU/baseV are normalized [0,1] across the plane; `aspect`
	corrects U distances so rings stay round on screen.

	Phase is the caller's effective-time integral (dtTs x Speed), so Timescale
	graphs  -  including negative segments  -  warp and reverse the animation.
]]

local Field = {}

-- Deterministic hash-based value noise (seedable, replay-stable; math.noise is
-- Roblox-only and lattice-zeroed at integers, so it is deliberately not used).
local function hash2(ix, iy, seed)
	local h = ix * 374761393 + iy * 668265263 + seed * 1442695040888963
	h = h % 2147483647
	h = (h * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
	return (h % 10000) / 10000
end

local function smooth(t)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

-- Single-octave value noise at (x, y).
local function valueNoise(x, y, seed)
	local ix = math.floor(x)
	local iy = math.floor(y)
	local fx = smooth(x - ix)
	local fy = smooth(y - iy)
	local a = hash2(ix, iy, seed)
	local b = hash2(ix + 1, iy, seed)
	local c = hash2(ix, iy + 1, seed)
	local d = hash2(ix + 1, iy + 1, seed)
	local ab = a + (b - a) * fx
	local cd = c + (d - c) * fx
	return (ab + (cd - ab) * fy) * 2 - 1
end

Field.valueNoise = valueNoise

-- Expanding ring from the epicenter. Wavefront sits at d == phase; a gaussian
-- window of width ~wavelength keeps a tight visible band around the front.
function Field.addRipple(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, epicU, epicV)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local wl = math.max(wavelength, 0.02)
	local invW = 1 / wl
	local twoPi = 2 * math.pi
	for i = 1, count do
		local dx = (baseU[i] - epicU) * aspect
		local dy = baseV[i] - epicV
		local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		local front = (d - phase) * invW
		height[i] += amp * math.cos(twoPi * front) * math.exp(-front * front * 4)
	end
end

-- Directional traveling sine wave. dirRad = travel direction in plane space.
function Field.addWave(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local wl = math.max(wavelength, 0.02)
	local kx = math.cos(dirRad) / wl
	local ky = math.sin(dirRad) / wl
	local twoPi = 2 * math.pi
	for i = 1, count do
		local s = baseU[i] * aspect * kx + baseV[i] * ky
		height[i] += amp * math.sin(twoPi * (s - phase / wl))
	end
end

-- 2-octave scrolling value noise; scroll direction dirRad, seed decorrelates
-- concurrent effects.
function Field.addNoise(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, scale, phase, dirRad, seed)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local sx = math.cos(dirRad) * phase
	local sy = math.sin(dirRad) * phase
	for i = 1, count do
		local u = (baseU[i] * aspect - sx) * scale
		local v = (baseV[i] - sy) * scale
		height[i] += amp * (valueNoise(u, v, seed) + 0.5 * valueNoise(u * 2.13, v * 2.13, seed + 71))
	end
end

-- Static lens dome: sign of amp picks bulge (+) or pinch (-). Phase-independent.
function Field.addLens(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, radius, epicU, epicV)
	if amp == 0 then return end
	local r = math.max(radius, 0.02)
	local invR2 = 1 / (r * r)
	for i = 1, count do
		local dx = (baseU[i] - epicU) * aspect
		local dy = baseV[i] - epicV
		local q = 1 - (dx * dx + dy * dy) * invR2
		if q > 0 then
			height[i] += amp * q * q
		end
	end
end

-- Zero the height buffer (table.clear nils entries; the hot loop needs 0s).
function Field.zero(height, count)
	for i = 1, count do
		height[i] = 0
	end
end

-- Dispatch one contribution by kind id (1 Ripple, 2 Wave, 3 Noise, 4 Bulge,
-- 5 Pinch). Bulge/Pinch share addLens with signed amp.
function Field.accumulate(kindId, height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad, noiseScale, lensRadius, epicU, epicV, seed)
	if kindId == 1 then
		Field.addRipple(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, epicU, epicV)
	elseif kindId == 2 then
		Field.addWave(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, wavelength, phase, dirRad)
	elseif kindId == 3 then
		Field.addNoise(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, noiseScale, phase, dirRad, seed)
	elseif kindId == 4 then
		Field.addLens(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, amp, lensRadius, epicU, epicV)
	elseif kindId == 5 then
		Field.addLens(height, baseU, baseV, count, aspect, -amp, lensRadius, epicU, epicV)
	end
end

return Field

--[[
	Distortion/PlaneBuilder  -  constructs the shared canvas backends.

	Mesh tier: EditableMesh grid plane, unit XY extents ([-0.5..0.5]), tiny baked
	Z relief so MeshSize has a nonzero Z (a degenerate flat mesh renders nothing).
	Canvas drives screen coverage via MeshPart.Size X/Y per frame and TRUE-stud
	height via vertex Z (Size.Z = MeshSize.Z keeps Z 1:1), so the per-frame write
	is Z-only. Single-sided winding toward local +Z (the camera).

	Tile tier: RES_TW x RES_TH squashed-Ball glass lenses on a shallow sphere
	section (each facing the camera); per-tile Transparency is the strength knob.
	Verified: gaps between tiles stay (overlapping glass culls itself).

	Both tiers carry the verified render recipe: Glass + Highlight child
	(FillTransparency 1, OutlineTransparency 0.98).
]]

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

local PlaneBuilder = {}

PlaneBuilder.RES_W = 24
PlaneBuilder.RES_H = 14
PlaneBuilder.TILE_W = 8
PlaneBuilder.TILE_H = 5

local function addRecipeHighlight(part)
	local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
	hl.FillTransparency = 1
	hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.98
	hl.Parent = part
	return hl
end

local function configurePart(part)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	-- Locked keeps the canvas from being picked by a click in the Studio viewport.
	part.Locked = true
	part.Archivable = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

-- Capability probe: EditableMesh creation can be permission-gated (published
-- games without the Mesh/Image APIs toggle) or return nil on memory budget.
function PlaneBuilder.probeMesh()
	local ok, em = pcall(function()
		return AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
	end)
	if ok and em then
		pcall(function() em:Destroy() end)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Build the mesh-tier canvas at the given grid resolution (defaults RES_W x
-- RES_H). YIELDS (CreateMeshPartAsync)  -  caller wraps in task.spawn and treats
-- the canvas as "building" until the callback fires.
-- Returns nil on failure (memory budget / permissions drift mid-session).
function PlaneBuilder.buildMesh(resW, resH)
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
		if not em then return nil end
		local W = resW or PlaneBuilder.RES_W
		local H = resH or PlaneBuilder.RES_H
		local ids = table.create(W * H)
		local baseX = table.create(W * H)
		local baseY = table.create(W * H)
		for gy = 0, H - 1 do
			for gx = 0, W - 1 do
				local x = gx / (W - 1) - 0.5
				local y = gy / (H - 1) - 0.5
				-- Baked corner relief: nonzero Z bounds without disturbing the
				-- visually flat center (amplitude far below visible refraction).
				local z = ((gx + gy) % 2 == 0) and 0.004 or -0.004
				local k = gy * W + gx + 1
				ids[k] = em:AddVertex(Vector3.new(x, y, z))
				baseX[k] = x
				baseY[k] = y
			end
		end
		-- Auto vertex normals are REQUIRED: the tilted normals of the displaced
		-- grid ARE the glass refraction. Pinning them flat kills the warp
		-- entirely (verified the hard way). The sun-smear side effect is handled
		-- by Canvas's sun-hole mask, not here.
		for gy = 0, H - 2 do
			for gx = 0, W - 2 do
				local a = ids[gy * W + gx + 1]
				local b = ids[gy * W + gx + 2]
				local c = ids[(gy + 1) * W + gx + 1]
				local d = ids[(gy + 1) * W + gx + 2]
				-- Winding faces local +Z (verified single-sided requirement).
				em:AddTriangle(a, b, d)
				em:AddTriangle(a, d, c)
			end
		end
		local mp = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
		mp.Name = "__PartIclesDistortion"
		configurePart(mp)
		mp.Size = mp.MeshSize
		local hl = addRecipeHighlight(mp)
		return { part = mp, em = em, ids = ids, baseX = baseX, baseY = baseY,
			meshSizeZ = mp.MeshSize.Z, highlight = hl, resW = W, resH = H }
	end)
	if ok then return result end
	return nil
end

-- Build the tile-tier canvas: model of lens parts + their view-sphere angular
-- offsets (Canvas re-aims each tile from the live camera every frame).
function PlaneBuilder.buildTiles()
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "__PartIclesDistortion"
	local tiles = {}
	local highlights = {}
	local yawAng = {}
	local pitchAng = {}
	local TW, TH = PlaneBuilder.TILE_W, PlaneBuilder.TILE_H
	local spacing = math.rad(10)
	local n = 0
	for gy = 1, TH do
		for gx = 1, TW do
			local lens = Instance.new("Part")
			lens.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			lens.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.26)
			configurePart(lens)
			lens.Transparency = 1
			lens.Name = "Lens" .. gx .. "_" .. gy
			lens.Parent = model
			n += 1
			tiles[n] = lens
			highlights[n] = addRecipeHighlight(lens)
			yawAng[n] = -(gx - (TW + 1) / 2) * spacing
			pitchAng[n] = (gy - (TH + 1) / 2) * spacing
		end
	end
	return { model = model, tiles = tiles, highlights = highlights, yawAng = yawAng,
		pitchAng = pitchAng, count = n, writeCFs = table.create(n) }
end

return PlaneBuilder

--[[
	Duration  -  compute true real-time wallclock for an emit dispatch.
	Honors EmitDelay, EmitDuration ranges, AnimateLoop, PartLife, and Timescale
	graph distortion (numerical integration; piecewise-linear graphs have no closed form).
	Returns nil to signal "effectively infinite" (AnimateLoop unbounded, Timescale=0,
	or Timescale clamps to a sign that never reaches the death boundary).
]]

local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local Duration = {}

local INTEGRATION_STEPS = 200

local function resolveDuration(raw)
	if raw == nil then return 0 end
	if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
	local vals = {}
	for v in tostring(raw):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
		if n then table.insert(vals, n) end
	end
	if #vals == 0 then return 0 end
	if #vals == 1 then return vals[1] end
	return math.max(vals[1], vals[2])
end

-- Wallclock time from spawn to death for one particle authored with the given
-- lifetime + Timescale curve. Two-phase: integrate ts(real_i) for real_i in [0,1]
-- (wall time 0 → lifetime), then if effective hasn't crossed the boundary, extend
-- with the terminal ts(1) value held constant until the boundary is reached.
function Duration.computeTrueLifetime(lifetime, timescaleGraph, seed)
	if not lifetime or lifetime <= 0 then return 0 end
	if not timescaleGraph then return lifetime end

	if Graph.IsStatic(timescaleGraph) then
		local v = Graph.GetStaticValue(timescaleGraph, 1)
		if v == 1 then return lifetime end
		if v == 0 then return nil end
		if v > 0 then return lifetime / v end
		return lifetime / (-v)
	end

	local seed_ = seed or {}
	local ts0 = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(0, timescaleGraph, seed_)
	local reverse = ts0 < 0
	local eff = reverse and lifetime or 0
	local realT = 0
	local dRealT = lifetime / INTEGRATION_STEPS

	for i = 1, INTEGRATION_STEPS do
		local real_i = i / INTEGRATION_STEPS
		local ts = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, timescaleGraph, seed_)
		local prevEff = eff
		eff = eff + ts * dRealT
		if not reverse and eff >= lifetime then
			local frac = (lifetime - prevEff) / (eff - prevEff)
			return realT + frac * dRealT
		end
		if reverse and eff <= 0 then
			local frac = prevEff / (prevEff - eff)
			return realT + frac * dRealT
		end
		realT = realT + dRealT
	end

	-- Phase 2: real_i clamps at 1, ts stays constant at ts(1) per Update.luau math.
	local tsTerminal = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(1, timescaleGraph, seed_)
	if reverse then
		if tsTerminal >= 0 then return nil end
		return realT + eff / (-tsTerminal)
	end
	if tsTerminal <= 0 then return nil end
	return realT + (lifetime - eff) / tsTerminal
end

-- Returns a lifecycle descriptor for a single item, or nil when the item is not
-- fire-eligible (no count, no duration, not a recognized emitter type). `overrides`
-- (EmitAt options Count / Delay / Duration) replace a transformed item's attributes.
-- Descriptor fields:
--   emitDelay   = scheduling delay before this item starts firing
--   emitDur     = burst window or continuous-Enable duration in seconds
--   lifecycle   = trailing real-time after emit ends until the last spawned particle dies
--   infinite    = true when this item is unbounded (AnimateLoop without EmitDuration,
--                 or Timescale that never reaches the death boundary)
function Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item, overrides)
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		local config = item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")
		local emitDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
		local emitDur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
		local rawCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		local count = rawCount == nil and 1 or rawCount
		if overrides then
			if overrides.Delay ~= nil then emitDelay = overrides.Delay end
			if overrides.Duration ~= nil then emitDur = resolveDuration(overrides.Duration) end
			if overrides.Count ~= nil then count = overrides.Count end
		end
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") or "Emit"
		local animateLoop = item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == true

		if emissionMode == "Animate" and animateLoop and emitDur <= 0 then
			return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = 0, lifecycle = 0, infinite = true }
		end
		local fires = (count > 0) or (emitDur > 0) or (emissionMode == "Animate")
		if not fires then return nil end

		local lifetime = config and config:GetAttribute("Lifetime")
		local lifetimeMax = 0
		if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then lifetimeMax = lifetime.Max
		elseif type(lifetime) == "number" then lifetimeMax = lifetime end

		local timescale = config and config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		local trueLife = Duration.computeTrueLifetime(lifetimeMax, timescale, nil)
		if trueLife == nil then
			return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = 0, infinite = true }
		end

		local partLife = (config and config:GetAttribute("PartLife")) or 0
		-- Animate mode runs at minimum one full lifecycle even with EmitDuration=0.
		if emissionMode == "Animate" and trueLife > emitDur then emitDur = trueLife end

		return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = trueLife + partLife, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		local rawCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		local count = rawCount == nil and 1 or rawCount
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local emitDur = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		if count <= 0 and emitDur <= 0 then return nil end
		local life = item.Lifetime
		local lifeMax = (typeof(life) == "NumberRange" and life.Max) or 0
		return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = lifeMax, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		local tDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
		local tDur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
		if tDur <= 0 then return nil end
		return { emitDelay = tDelay, emitDur = tDur, lifecycle = item.Lifetime or 0, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		local bDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local bDur = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		if bDur <= 0 then return nil end
		return { emitDelay = bDelay, emitDur = bDur, lifecycle = 0, infinite = false }
	end

	return nil
end

-- Recursive walk. Returns the max finish-time across this item and its emit-eligible
-- descendants, OR nil if any branch is infinite. Mirrors EmitDispatch.descendantMaxEmitTime
-- traversal: transformed-no-op short-circuits subtree, RenderTemplate children only
-- recurse into transformed descendants (nested per-clone emitters). `overrides` reach the
-- items the call fires directly, never the nested emitters inside a RenderTemplate.
function Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, accumDelay, overrides)
	if not item then return 0 end
	accumDelay = accumDelay or 0

	local info = Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item, overrides)
	local myFinish = 0
	local childAccum = accumDelay
	local skipChildren = false

	if info then
		if info.infinite then return nil end
		myFinish = accumDelay + info.emitDelay + info.emitDur + info.lifecycle
		childAccum = accumDelay + info.emitDelay
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			-- Transformed-but-no-fire would have returned nil above; non-fire descendants
			-- inside a transformed item don't run as their own AbsoluteEmit.
		end
	else
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			skipChildren = true
		end
	end

	if not skipChildren then
		for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == "RenderTemplate" then
				for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
					if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
						local sub = Duration.computeMaxDuration(desc, childAccum)
						if sub == nil then return nil end
						if sub > myFinish then myFinish = sub end
					end
				end
			else
				local sub = Duration.computeMaxDuration(child, childAccum, overrides)
				if sub == nil then return nil end
				if sub > myFinish then myFinish = sub end
			end
		end
	end

	return myFinish
end

return Duration

--[[
	Emit Mixin  -  per-type one-shot emit for Part / Beam (Attachment lives in EmitAttachment.luau).
	Clones RT, computes initial CFrame + direction, pushes pData onto Particle.ActiveEmits.
	Motion math shared with Motion Preview via PreSimulateForward / PreSimulateAttachmentForward.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local shapeFunctions = Constants.shapeFunctions

return function(Particle)

-- One Part emit. Initial CFrame: link/LinkMode → Shape offset → RotXYZ → Position offset
-- → strip rotation if DirMode=Global. InvertMotion pre-simulates to endpoint.
-- emitCtx (optional): {ChainCtx, EmitIndex, EventOriginCF, EventOriginResolver, IgnoreLink, UseFullOrigin}
-- EventOriginResolver wins over EventOriginCF (live vs snapshot).
function Particle:EmitPart(part, link, emitCtx)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(part, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.IgnoreLink then
		link = nil
	else
		link = link or data.Link
	end

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)
	-- Follow drops link rotation; Weld/Pivot compose it.
	local unrotatedCF
	local originOverrideCF
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		if not originOverrideCF then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginCF end
	end
	if originOverrideCF then
		if emitCtx and emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
			unrotatedCF = originOverrideCF -- AtCFrame: full source orientation
		else
			-- AtPosition / AtSource: replace position only, keep target rotation.
			unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(originOverrideCF.Position) * part.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	elseif link then
		unrotatedCF = LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, part, part.CFrame, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, emitCtx and emitCtx._sourceParentCF, spawnAxes)
	else unrotatedCF = part.CFrame end
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier

	-- Shape branch. UseShape gates; shape function returns offset / rotation / outward direction.
	-- ShapePart override: when set, sample volume + spawn position in ShapePart's frame.
	-- nil falls back to existing source-frame behavior (unrotatedCF).
	local localOffset = Vector3.new()
	local shapeDir = nil
	local initialCF = unrotatedCF
	if data.UseShape then
		local shapeFunc = shapeFunctions[data.ParticleData.Shape]
		if shapeFunc then
			local shapeSrc = data.ShapePart or part
			local shapeCF = data.ShapePart and data.ShapePart.CFrame or unrotatedCF
			local sOffset, sRotation, sDirVec = shapeFunc(shapeSrc, data.ParticleData)
			localOffset = sOffset
			local sio = data.ParticleData.ShapeInOut
			if sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
				sDirVec = -sDirVec
			elseif sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut then
				if math.random() < 0.5 then sDirVec = -sDirVec end
			end
			shapeDir = (shapeCF - shapeCF.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(sDirVec)
			if data.ParticleData.LookAtInitially then
				local rx, ry, rz = initialCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position)
					* sRotation * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
			else
				initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
			end
		else
			initialCF = CFrame.new((initialCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
		end
	else
		initialCF = CFrame.new((initialCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
	end

	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	initialCF = initialCF * rotXYZ

	-- Nested-Model scale: scatter the spawn Pos spread by the parent Model's scale at THIS
	-- emit moment (Pos spread is a one-time spawn offset; per-frame motion scales separately).
	local posScale = 1
	local psInfo = emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale
	if psInfo and psInfo.ScaleMotion ~= false then
		posScale = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(psInfo, os.clock(), GraphMod)
	end
	initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, data, link, part, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, nil, posScale)

	-- Global DirMode: drop emitter+link rotation; keep RotXYZ.
	if dirMode == "Global" then
		initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
	end

	local baseDirection
	if shapeDir then
		baseDirection = shapeDir
	elseif dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	else
		baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
	end
	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		SizeX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeX), SizeY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeY), SizeZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeZ),
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX), RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY), RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX), PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY), PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed), Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		AccelStrength = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.AccelStrength),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}

	-- Axis-link alias: followers adopt primary's seed + graph; mutates data + seeds in-place.
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil

	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, Time, nil, initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(), emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes and part.CFrame or nil)
	end

	local visualPart = Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(data.RenderTemplate, "Part", data.Pool)
	visualPart.Archivable = false
	local parentCF_now = LinkCF.emitParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, part.CFrame)
	local localCF

	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		-- Place at endpoint of forward sim. Index by effective TKF since presim caps at 500.
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
		visualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
	else
		localCF = link and parentCF_now:ToObjectSpace(initialCF) or initialCF
		visualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Part",
		VisualPart = visualPart,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil,
		-- RigidLocal: snapshot the link's at-emit parent CFrame. Per-frame Link
		-- consumers (LinkTrack / getLinkCF / Bounce) read this instead of the live
		-- link CFrame. nil for non-RigidLocal modes.
		_rigidLocalParentCF = LinkCF.rigidSnapshot(data.LinkMode, link, parentCF_now),
		Events = data.Events,
		SpecialMesh = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SpecialMesh'),
		Decal = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal'),
		-- SurfaceAppearance: flipbook routes to ColorMap, Transparency/Color graphs drive MeshPart
		-- because SurfaceAppearance has no per-instance Transparency / Color3 surface.
		SurfaceAppearance = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceAppearance'),

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time,
		PartLife = data.PartLife,
		CurrentPosition = visualPart.Position,
		LocalCF = localCF,

		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		-- Accumulated velocity contribution from Acceleration. Tracked explicitly so OnHit
		-- Bounce can reflect it along the hit normal (a closed-form `accel * elapsedSec`
		-- would keep integrating from t=0 across a bounce, diverging from physics).
		_accelVel = Vector3.zero,
		-- Speed multiplier: scales the speed graph's output. Compounds across bounces
		-- when Bounciness < 1  -  each bounce loses energy along the normal, so the
		-- particle's effective speed decreases on impact.
		SpeedMultiplier = 1,
		-- Persistent angular velocity from collision impulses (deg/sec, world axes).
		-- Bounce's tangential drag converts to spin; this rate compounds with each
		-- glancing impact. _spinAccum tracks the integrated rotation contribution.
		_spinRate = Vector3.zero,
		_spinAccumX = 0,
		_spinAccumY = 0,
		_spinAccumZ = 0,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,
		_localWorldCF = localCF, -- seed for LinkTrack frame 0

		-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z trajectory state. DisplacementMode selects which rotation
		-- to apply: Local = SpawnRotation (post-RotXYZ particle frame); RigidLocal
		-- = SpawnEmitterRotation (same frame as SpawnRotation but with the per-
		-- particle RotXYZ contribution algebraically removed via rotXYZ:Inverse());
		-- Global = no rotation. HasPosOffsetGraphs gates per-frame work.
		SpawnRotation = localCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		-- Body bbox half-diagonal for Jolt-style point-velocity sleep check.
		-- Captures rotation-induced edge speed when CoM is near-stationary.
		_sleepRadius = (visualPart and visualPart:IsA("BasePart") and visualPart.Size.Magnitude * 0.5) or 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		-- Target-accel: target.Position read live each frame, target ref fixed at emit.
		-- Disabled with InvertMotion (cached SimLocalCFrames can't track moving targets).
		HasTargetAccel = data.AccelerationTowardsInstance == true and data.AccelTarget ~= nil and data.AccelStrength ~= nil and not data.InvertMotion,
		AccelTarget = data.AccelTarget,
		TargetVel = Vector3.zero,
		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,
		HasDecal = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal') ~= nil,
		DecalLayersMode = data.DecalLayersMode,

		Graphs = {
			SizeX = data.SizeX, SizeY = data.SizeY, SizeZ = data.SizeZ,
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Speed = data.Speed, Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency, Color = data.Color,
			AccelStrength = data.AccelStrength,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},

		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),
	}

	-- 1-frame pop prevention for PosOffset graphs: sample at t=0, apply to spawn
	-- pose so frame-0 visual already includes the initial offset. Initialize
	-- _prevWorldOff to worldOff(0) so the first Update step's delta is measured
	-- from this baseline (not from zero  -  which would cause a teleport at step 1
	-- for front-loaded curves where posOff ramps fast initially).
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
		end
	end
	Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)

	-- 1-frame pop prevention.
	local startSize = Vector3.new(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeX, pData.Seeds.SizeX), GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeY, pData.Seeds.SizeY), GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeZ, pData.Seeds.SizeZ))
	local startTrans = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)
	local startColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Color)
	local startBright = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)

	if pData.SpecialMesh then
		pData.SpecialMesh.Scale = startSize
	else
		pData.VisualPart.Size = startSize
	end

	if pData.SurfaceAppearance then
		-- Color graph tints SA.Color raw; Brightness graph drives SA.EmissiveTint only.
		-- EmissiveTint write pcall-guarded for older Studio builds without the property.
		pData.VisualPart.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
		pData.SurfaceAppearance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
		pcall(function() pData.SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveTint = Color3.new(startColor.R * startBright, startColor.G * startBright, startColor.B * startBright) end)
	elseif pData.Decal and not data.DecalLayersMode then
		pData.Decal.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255 * startBright, startColor.G * 255 * startBright, startColor.B * 255 * startBright)
	else
		-- Mesh: Brightness scales the mesh colour in decal-layers mode; legacy plain meshes ignore it.
		local meshBright = data.DecalLayersMode and startBright or 1
		pData.VisualPart.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255 * meshBright, startColor.G * 255 * meshBright, startColor.B * 255 * meshBright)
	end

	-- Disable PEs BEFORE Parent so they don't auto-emit on workspace entry;
	-- EnableEmitSingle below controls their timing.
	for _, desc in visualPart:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then desc.Enabled = false end
	end

	visualPart.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	for _, desc in visualPart:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("Trail") then
			if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then continue end
			local underTransformed = false
			local cur = desc.Parent
			while cur and cur ~= visualPart do
				if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then underTransformed = true; break end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			if underTransformed then continue end
			local dur = desc:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")
			if dur ~= nil then
				if desc.Enabled ~= true then
					desc.Enabled = true
				end
				if desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled") ~= nil then
					desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", true)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Restore pooled Trails (deferred 1 Heartbeat). Snapshot was synced above
	-- so this is consistent with our pre-Parent enable for fresh emits.
	Pool.restoreTrails(visualPart, "Part")

	-- EnableEmitSingle schedules the EmitDuration-end Trail.Enabled=false and
	-- the PE Emit(count) burst. Trail.Enabled=true was already set above; this
	-- just registers the disable timer + PE emission.
	local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, child in visualPart:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then ParticlesMod.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(child, alive) end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(child, alive)
	end

	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
	end

	pData._sourceItem = part
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, part)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Part" end
	-- Static-graph short-circuit: constant-valued graphs nil out + stamp pData._static<Name>.
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	-- _applyEmitVisualPasses MUST precede _registerEmit (OnEmit payload reads post-pass CFrame).
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Decal layers bind after Parent: the layer flipbook task exits while the visual is unparented.
	DecalLayersMod.attach(pData, data, visualPart, Time, false)
	MeshFramesMod.attach(pData, data, visualPart, Time, false)
	-- Flipbook target: SA.ColorMap if present, else Decal.Texture, else MeshPart.TextureID
	-- when the visual is a plain MeshPart with no Decal/SA child to write to. Textured mesh
	-- frames carry their own TextureID through ApplyMesh, so they take the MeshPart instead.
	if data.CachedMeshTextures and #data.CachedMeshTextures > 0 then
		local flipTarget = pData.SurfaceAppearance
		if not flipTarget and not data.DecalLayersMode and not data.MeshFramesTextured then flipTarget = pData.Decal end
		if not flipTarget and visualPart:IsA("MeshPart") and not pData.Layers and not data.MeshFramesTextured then flipTarget = visualPart end
		if flipTarget then
			MeshFlipMod.Flip(pData, data.ParticleData, data.CachedMeshTextures, flipTarget, Time)
		end
	end

	-- Nested Part-Icles: source-walk; link = visualPart drives position. See NestedEmit.luau.
	-- The inherited Model-scale chain node is forwarded to deeper nested
	-- particles, so Model→Part→Part keeps scaling (a Part adds no factor, just propagates).
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, visualPart, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, pData.ParentScale)
end

-- Beams: no spatial motion (welded to Attachment0/1). Animation via per-prop graphs,
-- GraphBlender, and BeamFlipbooks. Static graphs read once at emit.
function Particle:EmitBeam(beam, link, emitCtx)
	if not beam or not beam.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(beam, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide flipped Enabled=false on release; flip back here.
	local visualBeam = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "Beam", data.Pool)
	visualBeam.Archivable = false
	visualBeam.Enabled = true
	if data.FaceCamera ~= nil then visualBeam.FaceCamera = data.FaceCamera end
	if data.ZOffset ~= nil then visualBeam.ZOffset = data.ZOffset end
	if data.TextureMode ~= nil then visualBeam.TextureMode = data.TextureMode end

	-- Bind the ends from the AUTHORED RT references (a pooled visual still carries a previous
	-- parent's clone attachments): the parent clone's copy when one exists, else the source.
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	local a0, a1 = data.RenderTemplate.Attachment0, data.RenderTemplate.Attachment1
	local c0 = map and a0 and map[a0]
	local c1 = map and a1 and map[a1]
	visualBeam.Attachment0 = (c0 and c0.Parent) and c0 or a0
	visualBeam.Attachment1 = (c1 and c1.Parent) and c1 or a1

	-- Static / animated beam property split.
	local animatedProps = {}
	for name, sequence in pairs(data.BeamProps) do
		if sequence then
			if GraphMod.IsStatic(sequence) then
				visualBeam[name] = GraphMod.GetStaticValue(sequence, visualBeam[name])
			else
				local seed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(sequence)
				animatedProps[name] = { Sequence = sequence, Seed = seed }
				if name ~= "TextureSpeed" then
					local initVal = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, sequence, seed)
					if name == "Segments" then initVal = math.max(20, math.round(initVal)) end
					visualBeam[name] = initVal
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Disable engine TextureSpeed accumulation; UpdateBeam computes offset.
	if animatedProps.TextureSpeed then
		visualBeam.TextureSpeed = 0
	end

	local transStates, colorStates = GraphMod.CollectGraphStates(data.GraphBlender)

	-- Cache merged keypoint times per adjacent pair.
	local transMergedTimes = {}
	for idx = 1, #transStates - 1 do
		transMergedTimes[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedTimes(transStates[idx].Graph, transStates[idx + 1].Graph)
	end
	local colorMergedTimes = {}
	for idx = 1, #colorStates - 1 do
		colorMergedTimes[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(colorStates[idx].Graph, colorStates[idx + 1].Graph)
	end

	-- Apply initial blender state (1-frame pop prevention).
	if #transStates > 0 then visualBeam.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visualBeam.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	visualBeam.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	local beamTimescaleSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.BeamTimescale)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Beam",
		VisualPart = visualBeam,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		AnimatedProps = animatedProps,

		TransStates = transStates,
		ColorStates = colorStates,
		TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes,
		ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,

		Graphs = { Timescale = data.BeamTimescale },
		Seeds = { Timescale = beamTimescaleSeed },
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.BeamTimescale, beamTimescaleSeed, safeLifeTime),
	}

	-- Inherit parent model scale; cache bases for static props.
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
		pData._baseWidth0 = visualBeam.Width0
		pData._baseWidth1 = visualBeam.Width1
		pData._baseCurveSize0 = visualBeam.CurveSize0
		pData._baseCurveSize1 = visualBeam.CurveSize1
		pData._baseTextureLength = visualBeam.TextureLength
		pData._baseSegments = visualBeam.Segments
	end

	pData._sourceItem = beam
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, beam)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Beam" end
	-- No _applyEmitVisualPasses for Beam (spatial-mesh only).
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	if data.CachedBeamTextures and #data.CachedBeamTextures > 0 and data.FlipbookParticle then
		MeshFlipMod.FlipBeam(pData, data.FlipbookParticle, data.CachedBeamTextures, visualBeam, safeLifeTime)
	end
end

end

--[[
	EmitAnimate Mixin  -  Animate-mode emit for Part / Attachment / Beam.
	Operates on RenderTemplate directly (no clone). On Lifetime expiry, init.luau's Heartbeat
	resets position + snapshots; with AnimateLoop=true it replays. AnimateItem stamps pData
	for the loop branch. Screen / ImageLabel animate lives in ScreenEmit / ImageEmit.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local shapeFunctions = Constants.shapeFunctions

return function(Particle)

-- Part Animate. Mirrors Emit.luau but visualPart = LIVE RenderTemplate.
function Particle:EmitPartAnimate(part, link, emitCtx)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(part, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	link = link or data.Link

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	local visualPart = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source RT, not a clone
	local initialAnchorCF = visualPart.CFrame
	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)

	local unrotatedCF
	if link then
		unrotatedCF = LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, part, part.CFrame, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, emitCtx and emitCtx._sourceParentCF, spawnAxes)
	else unrotatedCF = part.CFrame end
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier

	-- Shape branch (see Emit.luau for full rationale). ShapePart override mirrors Emit.luau.
	local localOffset = Vector3.new()
	local shapeDir = nil
	local initialCF = unrotatedCF
	if data.UseShape then
		local shapeFunc = shapeFunctions[data.ParticleData.Shape]
		if shapeFunc then
			local shapeSrc = data.ShapePart or part
			local shapeCF = data.ShapePart and data.ShapePart.CFrame or unrotatedCF
			local sOffset, sRotation, sDirVec = shapeFunc(shapeSrc, data.ParticleData)
			localOffset = sOffset
			local sio = data.ParticleData.ShapeInOut
			if sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
				sDirVec = -sDirVec
			elseif sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut then
				if math.random() < 0.5 then sDirVec = -sDirVec end
			end
			shapeDir = (shapeCF - shapeCF.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(sDirVec)
			if data.ParticleData.LookAtInitially then
				local rx, ry, rz = initialCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position)
					* sRotation * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
			else
				initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
			end
		else
			initialCF = CFrame.new((initialCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
		end
	else
		initialCF = CFrame.new((initialCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
	end

	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	initialCF = initialCF * rotXYZ

	initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, data, link, part, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx)

	if dirMode == "Global" then
		initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
	end

	local baseDirection
	if shapeDir then
		baseDirection = shapeDir
	elseif dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	else
		baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
	end

	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		SizeX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeX), SizeY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeY), SizeZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeZ),
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX), RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY), RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX), PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY), PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed), Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		AccelStrength = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.AccelStrength),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil
	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, Time, nil, initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(), emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes and part.CFrame or nil)
	end

	local parentCF_now = LinkCF.emitParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, part.CFrame)
	local localCF
	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
	else
		localCF = link and parentCF_now:ToObjectSpace(initialCF) or initialCF
	end
	visualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF

	local pData = {
		Type = "Part",
		VisualPart = visualPart,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = LinkCF.rigidSnapshot(data.LinkMode, link, parentCF_now),
		Events = data.Events,
		SpecialMesh = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SpecialMesh'),
		Decal = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal'),
		-- SA has no per-instance Transparency/Color3; Color graph writes to SA.Color, MeshPart stays raw.
		SurfaceAppearance = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceAppearance'),
		-- Snapshot SA.Color + MeshPart.Color so finishAnimate restores authored tint.
		_initialSAColor = (function()
			local sa = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceAppearance')
			return sa and sa.Color or nil
		end)(),
		_initialPartColor = visualPart:IsA("BasePart") and visualPart.Color or nil,

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0, AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		CurrentPosition = visualPart.Position,
		LocalCF = localCF,

		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		-- AnimateLoop replay restores from this so Bounce reflections don't leak into next cycle.
		_initialBaseDirection = baseDirection,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,
		_localWorldCF = localCF,

		-- PosOffset trajectory state (see Emit.luau Part path for semantics).
		SpawnRotation = localCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		_sleepRadius = (visualPart and visualPart:IsA("BasePart") and visualPart.Size.Magnitude * 0.5) or 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,
		HasDecal = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal') ~= nil,
		DecalLayersMode = data.DecalLayersMode,
		-- InvertMotion + target-accel mutually exclusive (cached SimLocalCFrames can't track).
		HasTargetAccel = data.AccelerationTowardsInstance == true and data.AccelTarget ~= nil and data.AccelStrength ~= nil and not data.InvertMotion,
		AccelTarget = data.AccelTarget,
		TargetVel = Vector3.zero,

		Graphs = {
			SizeX = data.SizeX, SizeY = data.SizeY, SizeZ = data.SizeZ,
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Speed = data.Speed, Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency, Color = data.Color,
			AccelStrength = data.AccelStrength,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),

		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = part,
		InitialAnchorCF = initialAnchorCF, InitialLocalCF = localCF,
	}

	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
		end
	end
	Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)

	-- 1-frame pop prevention.
	local startSize = Vector3.new(
		GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeX, pData.Seeds.SizeX),
		GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeY, pData.Seeds.SizeY),
		GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeZ, pData.Seeds.SizeZ)
	)
	local startTrans = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)
	local startColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Color)
	local startBright = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)

	if pData.SpecialMesh then pData.SpecialMesh.Scale = startSize
	else pData.VisualPart.Size = startSize end

	if pData.SurfaceAppearance then
		-- Color graph tints SA.Color raw; Brightness graph drives SA.EmissiveTint only.
		pData.VisualPart.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
		pData.SurfaceAppearance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
		pcall(function() pData.SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveTint = Color3.new(startColor.R * startBright, startColor.G * startBright, startColor.B * startBright) end)
	elseif pData.Decal and not data.DecalLayersMode then
		pData.Decal.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255 * startBright, startColor.G * 255 * startBright, startColor.B * 255 * startBright)
	else
		local meshBright = data.DecalLayersMode and startBright or 1
		pData.VisualPart.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255 * meshBright, startColor.G * 255 * meshBright, startColor.B * 255 * meshBright)
	end
	DecalLayersMod.attach(pData, data, visualPart, Time, true)
	MeshFramesMod.attach(pData, data, visualPart, Time, true)

	-- LIVE source RT; EnableEmitSingle drives each child's per-cycle lifecycle.
	local alivePartAn = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, child in visualPart:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then ParticlesMod.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(child, alivePartAn) end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(child, alivePartAn)
	end

	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
	end

	pData._sourceItem = part
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, part)
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	self.ActiveAnimates[part] = pData
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Nested Part-Icles: same pruned, nested-driven walk as Emit mode; the live RT is both the
	-- source and the link.
	NestedEmit.walk(self, visualPart, visualPart, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, pData.ParentScale)
end

-- Attachment Animate. Parent-local sim mirrors EmitAttachment; visual is the RT child (not cloned).
function Particle:EmitAttachmentAnimate(attachment, link, emitCtx)
	if not attachment or not attachment.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(attachment, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	link = link or data.Link

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	local visualAttachment = data.RenderTemplate -- NOT a clone
	local initialAnchorCF = visualAttachment.CFrame

	-- Visual IS the RT child of the source Attachment; sim runs in source-local space so
	-- the visual's world pose composes via source.WorldCFrame * localCF. Unlinked, the spawn
	-- frame is the source itself (localCF = identity, Transform's RT.CFrame invariant); linked,
	-- the spawn frame comes from the link exactly as EmitAttachment does.
	local sourceWorldCF = attachment.WorldCFrame
	local spawnAxes = LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)
	local localCF = CFrame.new()
	if link then
		local worldCF = LinkCF.spawnFrame(data.LinkMode, link, attachment, sourceWorldCF, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, emitCtx and emitCtx._sourceParentCF, spawnAxes)
		localCF = sourceWorldCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
	end
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]

	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	local rotatedLocalCF = localCF * rotXYZ

	local baseDirection
	if dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = rotatedLocalCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		-- Convert world axis to source-local frame via source.WorldCFrame so the math
		-- works whether source is parented to BasePart, Attachment, or nested deeper.
		local worldAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		baseDirection = attachment.WorldCFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(worldAxis)
	else
		baseDirection = localCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	end

	localCF = rotatedLocalCF

	-- simFrameCF = source.WorldCFrame; sim runs in source-local frame (visual IS RT
	-- child of source). WorldCFrame composes arbitrary nest depth automatically.
	localCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(localCF, data, link, attachment, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, attachment.WorldCFrame)

	-- Global DirMode: world-align visual; cancel source.WorldRotation so the engine-
	-- composed (source.WorldCFrame * RT.CFrame) lands at rotXYZ in world space.
	if dirMode == "Global" then
		localCF = CFrame.new(localCF.Position) * attachment.WorldCFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * rotXYZ
	end

	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX),
		RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY),
		RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil
	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(data, seeds, localCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, Time, nil, localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse())
	end

	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		localCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
	end

	visualAttachment.CFrame = localCF

	-- LocalCF in link-parent space (source-local when unlinked), mirroring EmitAttachment.
	local pDataLocalCF = localCF
	if link then
		pDataLocalCF = LinkCF.emitAttachmentParentFrame(data.LinkMode, link, attachment, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, sourceWorldCF):ToObjectSpace(localCF)
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Attachment",
		VisualPart = visualAttachment,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_linkLocal = emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal or nil,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = LinkCF.rigidWorldSnapshot(data.LinkMode, link, emitCtx and emitCtx._linkLocal, spawnAxes, sourceWorldCF),
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0, AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		LocalCF = pDataLocalCF,
		_localWorldCF = pDataLocalCF,
		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		_initialBaseDirection = baseDirection,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,
		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,
		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,
		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,
		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,
		-- PosOffset trajectory state (see Emit.luau Part path for semantics).
		SpawnRotation = localCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		_sleepRadius = 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,
		Graphs = {
			Speed = data.Speed,
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = attachment,
		InitialAnchorCF = initialAnchorCF, InitialLocalCF = localCF,
	}

	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
		end
	end
	Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)

	pData._sourceItem = attachment
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, attachment)
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	self.ActiveAnimates[attachment] = pData
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
	end
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- LIVE source RT; EnableEmitSingle drives each child's per-cycle lifecycle.
	local aliveAttAn = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, child in visualAttachment:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then ParticlesMod.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(child, aliveAttAn) end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(child, aliveAttAn)
	end

	NestedEmit.walk(self, visualAttachment, visualAttachment, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx, pData.ParentScale)
end

-- Beam Animate. Static/animated split mirrors EmitBeam; visual is the LIVE RT.
function Particle:EmitBeamAnimate(beam, link, emitCtx)
	if not beam or not beam.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(beam, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visualBeam = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone
	-- Snapshot mutated properties so finishAnimate restores authored visual.
	local beamSnapshot = {
		Brightness = visualBeam.Brightness,
		CurveSize0 = visualBeam.CurveSize0,
		CurveSize1 = visualBeam.CurveSize1,
		Width0 = visualBeam.Width0,
		Width1 = visualBeam.Width1,
		LightEmission = visualBeam.LightEmission,
		LightInfluence = visualBeam.LightInfluence,
		Segments = visualBeam.Segments,
		TextureLength = visualBeam.TextureLength,
		TextureSpeed = visualBeam.TextureSpeed,
		Transparency = visualBeam.Transparency,
		Color = visualBeam.Color,
		FaceCamera = visualBeam.FaceCamera,
		Enabled = visualBeam.Enabled,
	}
	if data.FaceCamera ~= nil then visualBeam.FaceCamera = data.FaceCamera end

	-- Static / animated beam property split.
	local animatedProps = {}
	for name, sequence in pairs(data.BeamProps) do
		if sequence then
			if GraphMod.IsStatic(sequence) then
				visualBeam[name] = GraphMod.GetStaticValue(sequence, visualBeam[name])
			else
				local seed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(sequence)
				animatedProps[name] = { Sequence = sequence, Seed = seed }
				if name ~= "TextureSpeed" then
					local initVal = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, sequence, seed)
					if name == "Segments" then initVal = math.max(20, math.round(initVal)) end
					visualBeam[name] = initVal
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Disable engine TextureSpeed accumulation; UpdateBeam computes offset.
	if animatedProps.TextureSpeed then
		visualBeam.TextureSpeed = 0
	end

	local transStates, colorStates = GraphMod.CollectGraphStates(data.GraphBlender)

	local transMergedTimes = {}
	for idx = 1, #transStates - 1 do
		transMergedTimes[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedTimes(transStates[idx].Graph, transStates[idx + 1].Graph)
	end
	local colorMergedTimes = {}
	for idx = 1, #colorStates - 1 do
		colorMergedTimes[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(colorStates[idx].Graph, colorStates[idx + 1].Graph)
	end

	-- Apply initial blender state (1-frame pop prevention).
	if #transStates > 0 then visualBeam.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visualBeam.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	visualBeam.Enabled = true

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	local beamTimescaleSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.BeamTimescale)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Beam",
		VisualPart = visualBeam,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		AnimatedProps = animatedProps,
		TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		BeamSnapshot = beamSnapshot,
		Graphs = { Timescale = data.BeamTimescale },
		Seeds = { Timescale = beamTimescaleSeed },
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.BeamTimescale, beamTimescaleSeed, safeLifeTime),
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = beam,
	}

	-- Inherit parent model scale for live width scaling.
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.ParentScale then
		pData.ParentScale = emitCtx.ParentScale
		pData._baseWidth0 = visualBeam.Width0
		pData._baseWidth1 = visualBeam.Width1
		pData._baseCurveSize0 = visualBeam.CurveSize0
		pData._baseCurveSize1 = visualBeam.CurveSize1
		pData._baseTextureLength = visualBeam.TextureLength
		pData._baseSegments = visualBeam.Segments
	end

	pData._sourceItem = beam
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, beam)
	self.ActiveAnimates[beam] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Particle:_refreshAnimateNonSpatial lives in EngineReplay.luau (mixin).

end

--[[
	EmitAt  -  mixin: Particle:EnableEmitAt (one item) and Particle:AbsoluteEmitAt (item + descendants),
	the origin-override emits. Both return a PlayHandle scoped to the call.
]]

local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local PlayHandle = require(script.Parent.PlayHandle)
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.EventsSchema)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local _Duration = require(script.Parent.Duration)

-- Warn once per key: rejected calls and in-place fallbacks are authoring errors, not per-frame noise.
local warned = {}
local function warnOnce(key, message)
	if warned[key] then return end
	warned[key] = true
	Log.warn(message)
end

-- A node that cannot take an origin still emits in place. EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason is the
-- single source shared with Events/EmitTarget.
local function warnInPlace(node)
	local reason = EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason(node)
	if not reason then return end
	warnOnce(node.ClassName .. ":" .. tostring(node:GetAttribute("EmissionMode")),
		("[Part-Icles] EmitAt: %s emits in place: %s"):format(node:GetFullName(), reason))
end

-- Origin forms: CFrame as given; Vector3 = position only (the emitter keeps its rotation); an
-- instance with a frame (BasePart / Model / Attachment / Bone / Camera) = its live frame, re-read
-- at spawn so a delayed emit follows it. Returns cf, resolver, fullPose; or nil, reason.
local function resolveOrigin(origin, options)
	local kind = typeof(origin)
	local fullPose = options.UseFullOrigin ~= false
	if kind == "CFrame" then return origin, options.OriginResolver, fullPose end
	if kind == "Vector3" then return CFrame.new(origin), options.OriginResolver, false end
	if kind == "Instance" and (origin:IsA("PVInstance") or origin:IsA("Attachment") or origin:IsA("Camera")) then
		local resolver = options.OriginResolver or function()
			if origin.Parent == nil then return nil end
			return Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(origin)
		end
		return Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(origin), resolver, fullPose
	end
	local got = kind == "Instance" and origin.ClassName or kind
	return nil, ("origin must be a CFrame, a Vector3 or an instance with a position (got %s)"):format(got)
end

-- The play's link: "camera" or an Instance. nil when absent, or when Persist writes it to the source.
local function playLink(options)
	if options.Persist == true then return nil end
	local link = options.Link
	if link == "camera" then return workspace.CurrentCamera end
	if typeof(link) == "Instance" then return link end
	return nil
end

-- Per-play overrides carried on emitCtx.Overrides: EnableEmit reads Count / Delay / Duration,
-- GetEmitData reads LinkMode / EmitParent. Nothing is written to the source item.
local function buildOverrides(options)
	local overrides = {}
	if options.Persist ~= true then
		if options.LinkMode ~= nil then
			overrides.LinkMode = options.LinkMode
		elseif options.Link ~= nil then
			overrides.LinkMode = "Weld"
		end
		if options.EmitParent ~= nil then overrides.EmitParent = options.EmitParent end
	end
	if typeof(options.Count) == "number" then overrides.Count = options.Count end
	if typeof(options.Delay) == "number" then overrides.Delay = options.Delay end
	if options.Duration ~= nil then overrides.Duration = options.Duration end
	if next(overrides) == nil then return nil end
	return overrides
end

-- Persist = true: write Link / EmitParent onto the source as authored state.
local function persistAuthoring(self, node, options)
	if options.Link ~= nil then self:SetLink(node, options.Link, options.LinkMode or "Weld") end
	if options.EmitParent ~= nil then self:SetEmitParent(node, options.EmitParent) end
end

return function(Particle)

-- Shared per-call state for both entry points; nil (after a warning) when the call is rejected.
local function beginPlay(self, item, origin, options, apiName)
	self:_warnIfNotActivated(apiName)
	options = options or {}
	if not item or not item.Parent then
		warnOnce(apiName .. ":item", ("[Part-Icles] %s: item is nil or has no parent; nothing emitted."):format(apiName))
		return nil
	end
	local originCF, resolver, fullPose = resolveOrigin(origin, options)
	if not originCF then
		warnOnce(apiName .. ":" .. tostring(resolver), ("[Part-Icles] %s: %s; nothing emitted."):format(apiName, tostring(resolver)))
		return nil
	end
	local overrides = buildOverrides(options)
	local totalDur = _Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, 0, overrides)
	-- Per-play "ghost": every particle spawned by THIS call carries token; the returned
	-- PlayHandle scopes Disable / SetTimescale / GetParticles to this play, not the shared
	-- source. token.Loops collects continuous-loop tasks; token.Clones collects branch-B
	-- raw clones. Threaded via emitCtx._playToken → _registerEmit stamps each pData.
	local token = { Alive = true, Loops = {}, Clones = {}, Duration = totalDur }
	return {
		options = options,
		originCF = originCF,
		resolver = resolver,
		fullPose = fullPose,
		overrides = overrides,
		token = token,
		handle = PlayHandle.new(self, token),
		totalDur = totalDur,
		link = playLink(options),
		-- LinkOverride: spawn at the LIVE link CFrame and ignore the origin, so a delayed / moving-link
		-- emit follows the link instead of trailing at the call-time origin.
		linkWins = options.LinkOverride == true and options.Link ~= nil,
	}
end

-- emitCtx for one node; `originCF` / `resolver` are that node's own (offset for containers).
local function buildCtx(play, originCF, resolver)
	local options = play.options
	local ctx = {
		ChainCtx      = options.ChainCtx,
		UseFullOrigin = play.fullPose,
		-- A play link beats IgnoreLink (Events set IgnoreLink with no link of their own).
		IgnoreLink    = options.IgnoreLink == true and play.link == nil,
		EventDriven   = options.EventDriven == true,
		Overrides     = play.overrides,
		_playToken    = play.token,
		_playLink     = play.link,
	}
	-- linkWins drops the origin so Emit's link branch spawns at the live link.
	if not play.linkWins then
		ctx.EventOriginCF = originCF
		ctx.EventOriginResolver = resolver
	end
	return ctx
end

-- Transformed root: persist authoring when asked, then fire the engine pipeline.
local function emitTransformedRoot(self, item, play)
	warnInPlace(item)
	if play.options.Persist == true then persistAuthoring(self, item, play.options) end
	self:EnableEmit(item, play.link, buildCtx(play, play.originCF, play.resolver))
	return play.handle, play.totalDur
end

-- One transformed item at an origin. Options and returns as AbsoluteEmitAt; containers are its job.
function Particle:EnableEmitAt(item, origin, options)
	local play = beginPlay(self, item, origin, options, "EnableEmitAt")
	if not play then return PlayHandle.inert(self), 0 end
	if not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		warnOnce("EnableEmitAt:" .. item.ClassName, ("[Part-Icles] EnableEmitAt: %s is not a Part-Icle; use AbsoluteEmitAt for containers and raw emitters. Nothing emitted."):format(item:GetFullName()))
		return PlayHandle.inert(self), 0
	end
	return emitTransformedRoot(self, item, play)
end

-- Recursive :EnableEmitAt. Two-pass hybrid:
--
-- (A) `item` IS a transformed Part-Icle:
--   Emit via the existing engine pipeline with origin override threaded through
--   emitCtx. No clone of the source  -  engine handles nested transformed descendants
--   automatically via the standard emit pipeline.
--
-- (B) `item` is a non-transformed 3D container (BasePart / Model / Attachment):
--   Pass 1  -  every transformed Part-Icle descendant emits via engine pipeline with
--   per-node origin override (its authored offset from the container pivot, carried into
--   the origin). NO clone of any transformed item. Each Part-Icle's 60+ attributes /
--   RenderTemplate stay in place; only the engine's per-emit Pool.acquireOrClone is invoked.
--   Pass 2  -  clone the container WITHOUT its transformed descendants (stripped from
--   the clone) so only the non-transformed parts + raw PE / Trail / Beam survive.
--   Anchor + PivotTo the clone to the origin, parent into emit folder, fire raw
--   native dispatch on the clone, scheduled destroy after the clone's own duration.
--
-- Result: transformed Part-Icles use the lightweight engine-level origin override
-- (no 60+ attribute copy). Raw native emitters get their proper clone-and-place
-- treatment. Repeated calls are independent (each call clones a fresh raw subtree).
--
-- origin: CFrame; Vector3 (position only); or an instance with a frame, followed live.
--
-- options (optional table):
--   ChainCtx            event-chain context
--   OriginResolver      function() -> CFrame, evaluated at spawn time (live origin). On a
--                       container it is re-resolved per node so the layout survives EmitDelay
--   UseFullOrigin       bool; true carries the container layout + rotation into the origin
--                       (AtCFrame); false translates only, every node keeps its own rotation.
--                       Default true (a Vector3 origin is always position only)
