--[[
	EmitOverrides  -  Particle:GetEmitData: GetData plus the play's overrides (emitCtx.Overrides from
	EmitAt options). LinkMode and EmitParent replace the authored values on the fresh data table, so
	nothing is written to the source. Emit paths that read Link / LinkMode / EmitParent call this;
	types without link semantics keep GetData. EnableEmit applies Count / Delay / Duration itself.
]]

return function(Particle)

-- Fresh data table for `item` with the play's LinkMode / EmitParent applied.
function Particle:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	local data = self:GetData(item)
	local overrides = emitCtx and emitCtx.Overrides
	if not data or not overrides then return data end
	if overrides.LinkMode ~= nil then data.LinkMode = overrides.LinkMode end
	if overrides.EmitParent ~= nil then data.EmitParent = overrides.EmitParent end
	return data
end

end

--[[
	Engine mixin  -  per-frame engine step + Activate / Deactivate / GetFolder / GetPoolFolder.

	Activate connects the per-frame step that walks ActiveEmits → UpdateX, handles
	death, replays AnimateLoop cycles, and runs the OnHit raycast pass. On clients
	(incl. Studio edit) the step runs in the RENDER phase after camera + character
	updates so welded links read this frame's final pose; servers use Heartbeat.
	Deactivate is the symmetric teardown.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')

local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Events)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local CameraShakeApply = require(script.Parent.CameraShake.Apply)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)
-- Distortion canvas composes AFTER the shake write so the plane rides the
-- shaken camera in the same frame (order is load-bearing).
local DistortionCanvas = require(script.Parent.Distortion.Canvas)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)

-- Unique BindToRenderStep names: plugin engine + ReplicatedStorage runtime module can
-- both be active in one client DataModel. The serial alone is NOT unique across
-- module instances (each starts at 1, and UnbindFromRenderStep removes every
-- binding sharing the name  -  one engine's Deactivate would kill the other's
-- step); the per-instance token disambiguates.
local _bindSerial = 0
local _instanceToken = tostring({}):match("0x(%x+)") or tostring(math.random(1e9))

return function(Particle)

-- Start the per-frame step. Each tick walks ActiveEmits → UpdateX; replay on AnimateLoop, swap-pop on death.
function Particle:Activate()
	if self.Connection then return end

	-- Bump engine-session gen so pending closures from prior sessions bail.
	self._engineGen = (self._engineGen or 0) + 1

	-- Reset the not-activated warning latch so a Deactivate → Emit cycle re-warns
	-- on each new Activate session.
	self._notActivatedWarned = false

	-- Reconnect focus listeners (disconnected in Deactivate). Client-only.
	if RunService:IsClient() then
		if not self._focusConn then
			self._focusConn = UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
				self._focused = true
				self._unfocusedAt = 0
			end)
		end
		if not self._blurConn then
			self._blurConn = UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
				self._focused = false
				self._unfocusedAt = os.clock()
			end)
		end
	end

	-- Pin textures for PreloadTexture=true items already in scene.
	for _, service in ipairs({
		workspace,
		game:GetService("Lighting"),
		game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),
		game:GetService("StarterGui"),
		game:GetService("StarterPack"),
		game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst"),
	}) do
		pcall(function() self:Preload(service, false) end)
	end

	local step = function(dt)
		EventsMod.tickFrame()
		-- Pool tick before the empty-emits early-return so idle pools still TTL-evict.
		local currentTime = os.clock()
		Pool.tick(currentTime)
		-- Carriers mirror their anchor part before any particle reads its parent frame.
		VisualHost.tick()
		local emits = self.ActiveEmits
		-- Flush before the early return: the frame after the last shake dies must
		-- still remove its applied camera offset (idle cost = a few compares).
		if #emits == 0 then
			CameraShakeApply.applyFrame()
			DistortionCanvas.applyFrame()
			return
		end
		local camPos; do local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; if cam then camPos = cam.CFrame.Position end end
		-- Disable calls made from inside the loop (event Modules) queue on _afterStep instead of
		-- sweeping ActiveEmits under the iteration (Particle:Disable / PlayHandle:Disable check this).
		self._inStep = true
		local i = 1

		while i <= #emits do
			local pData = emits[i]
			-- _forceDead (payload.Kill) short-circuits the per-type Update for immediate death.
			local isDead = pData._forceDead == true
			-- Capture step pre-Update so the post-Update cache refresh detects step advance for unlinked particles.
			local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep

			if not isDead then
				if pData.Type == "Part" then
					isDead = self:UpdatePart(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Beam" then
					isDead = self:UpdateBeam(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "PointLight" then
					isDead = self:UpdatePointLight(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Highlight" then
					isDead = self:UpdateHighlight(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "TrailEmitter" then
					isDead = self:UpdateTrail(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Attachment" then
					isDead = self:UpdateAttachment(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Model" then
					isDead = self:UpdateModel(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Screen" then
					isDead = self:UpdateScreen(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "ImageLabel" then
					isDead = self:UpdateImageLabel(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Lightning" then
					isDead = self:UpdateLightning(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "CameraShake" then
					isDead = self:UpdateCameraShake(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Sound" then
					isDead = self:UpdateSound(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Rocks" then
					isDead = self:UpdateRocks(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Rope" then
					isDead = self:UpdateRope(pData, dt, currentTime)
				elseif pData.Type == "Distortion" then
					isDead = self:UpdateDistortion(pData, dt, currentTime)
				end
			end

			-- Per-frame passes run outside the step gate for smooth tracking between keyframes.
			-- Skip on dead particles to avoid one extra wasted frame + last-frame flicker.
			-- `_postUpdateCF` caches the pre-overlay base CFrame so Orientation and ZOffset
			-- can apply as ABSOLUTE overlays. Refresh whenever Update wrote a fresh CFrame
			-- this frame (CurrentStep advanced) or ReapplyLink writes one (every frame for
			-- linked particles). Unlinked between-step frames retain the last step's cache
			-- as the correct overlay base.
			if not isDead then
				if pData.Link then self:ReapplyLink(pData) end
				-- Settle pass post-Update so gravity-torque composes after step rotation.
				local t = pData.Type
				if pData._settleEngaged and not pData._collisionStopped
					and (t == "Part" or t == "Model" or t == "Attachment") then
					EventsCollision.applySettle(pData, dt)
				end
				-- Only Part / Model / Attachment consume `_postUpdateCF` via overlays. Beam,
				-- PointLight, Screen, ImageLabel have no `.CFrame` property  -  gate the cache
				-- write to the consumer types so a Beam with Link doesn't error every Heartbeat.
				if (t == "Part" or t == "Model" or t == "Attachment") and (pData.Link or pData.CurrentStep ~= prevStep) then pData._postUpdateCF = (t == "Model") and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame end
				if pData.Orientation and pData.Orientation ~= "None" then self:ApplyOrientation(pData, dt, camPos) end
				if pData.ZOffset and pData.ZOffset ~= 0 then self:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos) end
			end

			-- OnHit raycast: AFTER all visual-pass CFrame writes (ReapplyLink + Orientation
			-- + ZOffset), so the segment matches the rendered position rather than the
			-- mid-pass intermediate. Internal pData.Events.OnHit gate makes this a cheap
			-- no-op when not configured. Runs even on death frame so fast particles don't
			-- have a blind segment between last-update and removal.
			EventsMod.afterUpdate(self, pData, isDead, currentTime)

			if isDead then
				-- OnDeath fires before any swap-and-pop / animate restart. AnimateLoop
				-- replay also fires OnDeath every cycle boundary; replay branch resets
				-- _killedManually after this fire so the new cycle starts clean.
				self:_fireOnDeath(pData)
				if pData.IsAnimate then
					-- A soft-disabled play (PlayHandle:SoftDisable) finishes its cycle and does not replay.
					local playStopped = pData._playToken ~= nil and pData._playToken.Alive == false
					if not playStopped and pData.AnimateItem and pData.AnimateItem.Parent and pData.AnimateItem:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") then
						-- Cycle reset + replay body lives in EngineReplay.luau (500-line cap split).
						self:_replayAnimateCycle(pData, currentTime)
						i += 1
					else
						-- One-shot animate finish. PartLife keeps the visual at its last frame for N
						-- seconds before position reset + hide.
						local visualPart = pData.VisualPart
						local pType = pData.Type
						local initialAnchorCF = pData.InitialAnchorCF
						local initialScale = pData.InitialScale
						local hasDecal = pData.HasDecal
						local animateItem = pData.AnimateItem
						local partLife = pData.PartLife or 0
						local isSharedRT = self:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData)
						-- Per-cycle finish token. Each Animate cycle bumps `_animateFinishGen`
						-- on the source item; this finish closure captures the value at schedule
						-- time and bails if a newer cycle has armed its own finish since.
						local finishGen
						if animateItem then
							finishGen = (animateItem:GetAttribute("_animateFinishGen") or 0) + 1
							EngineAttr.write(animateItem, "_animateFinishGen", finishGen)
						end
						local function finishAnimate()
							if not visualPart or not visualPart.Parent then return end
							if isSharedRT and animateItem and self.ActiveAnimates[animateItem] then return end
							if animateItem and animateItem.Parent and finishGen and animateItem:GetAttribute("_animateFinishGen") ~= finishGen then return end
							-- OnDestruction fires JUST BEFORE the visual is restored/destroyed/hidden.
							-- AnimateLoop replay doesn't reach here (death-handler restarts cycle
							-- without calling finishAnimate), so this is genuinely terminal.
							self:_fireOnDestruction(pData, visualPart)
							if initialAnchorCF then
								if pType == "Model" then
									pcall(function() visualPart:PivotTo(initialAnchorCF) end)
									if initialScale then pcall(function() visualPart:ScaleTo(initialScale) end) end
								else pcall(function() visualPart.CFrame = initialAnchorCF end) end
							end
							if pType == "Screen" or pType == "ImageLabel" or pType == "Lightning" or pType == "Rocks" or pType == "Rope" then
								pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
							elseif pType == "Beam" or pType == "Highlight" or pType == "TrailEmitter" then
								local snap = pData.BeamSnapshot or pData.HighlightSnapshot or pData.TrailEmitterSnapshot
								if snap then
									pcall(function() for k, v in pairs(snap) do visualPart[k] = v end end)
								end
								pcall(function() visualPart.Enabled = false end)
							else
								DecalLayersMod.restore(pData)
								MeshFramesMod.restore(pData)
								pcall(function()
									visualPart.Transparency = 1
									if hasDecal then local d = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal"); if d then d.Transparency = 1 end end
									local sa = pData._initialSAColor and visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
									if sa then sa.Color = pData._initialSAColor end
									if pData._initialPartColor and visualPart:IsA("BasePart") then visualPart.Color = pData._initialPartColor end
								end)
							end
						end
						-- Clear ActiveAnimates BEFORE running finishAnimate (see prior comment block).
						self.ActiveAnimates[animateItem] = nil
						if partLife > 0 then task.delay(partLife, finishAnimate) else finishAnimate() end
						self:_reclaimPData(pData)
						-- A cancelAnimation raised from inside the loop may already have popped this entry.
						if emits[i] == pData then
							local n = #emits
							if i < n then emits[i] = emits[n] end
							emits[n] = nil
						end
					end
				else
					-- Normal emit: destroy visual, swap-and-pop. OnDestruction fires JUST
					-- BEFORE destroy (immediate path) or inside the deferred closure (linger
					-- path) so user scripts read the final pose pre-destroy.
					local visualPart = pData.VisualPart
					if pData.PartLife and pData.PartLife > 0 then
						-- Track this visualPart in self._lingerByItem so Particle:Disable
						-- can destroy linger clones early when Stop fires. Also bump the
						-- linger visual counter so MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES reflects rendered
						-- linger clones; flag the visual so each path that destroys it
						-- decrements at most once.
						local source = pData._sourceItem
						if source and visualPart then
							self._lingerByItem = self._lingerByItem or {}
							local list = self._lingerByItem[source] or {}
							table.insert(list, visualPart)
							self._lingerByItem[source] = list
							pcall(function() visualPart:SetAttribute("_lingerCounted", true) end)
							self._lingerVisualCount += 1
						end
						-- Stamp linger start so OnDestruction's payload.LingerElapsed
						-- can report actual time-in-linger when fired (early-Disable
						-- destroys mid-linger; full PartLife when delay completes).
						pData._lingerStartTime = os.clock()
						task.delay(pData.PartLife, function()
							self:_fireOnDestruction(pData, visualPart)
							if visualPart then
								local counted = false
								pcall(function() counted = visualPart:GetAttribute("_lingerCounted") == true end)
								if counted then
									self._lingerVisualCount = math.max(0, (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) - 1)
									pcall(function() visualPart:SetAttribute("_lingerCounted", nil) end)
								end
								-- Pool-eligible if non-animate and pData has source RT stamps
								-- (Emit.luau / EmitModel.luau / PointLight.luau set them).
								self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, visualPart)
							end
							if source and self._lingerByItem and self._lingerByItem[source] then
								local list = self._lingerByItem[source]
								for k = #list, 1, -1 do
									if list[k] == visualPart then
										local n = #list
										if k < n then list[k] = list[n] end
										list[n] = nil
									end
								end
								if #list == 0 then self._lingerByItem[source] = nil end
							end
						end)
					else
						-- PartLife=0: OnDestruction same-frame as OnDeath, then release/destroy.
						self:_fireOnDestruction(pData, visualPart)
						self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, visualPart)
					end
					self:_reclaimPData(pData)
					-- A cancelAnimation raised from inside the loop may already have popped this entry.
					if emits[i] == pData then
						local n = #emits
						if i < n then emits[i] = emits[n] end
						emits[n] = nil
					end
				end
			else
				i += 1
			end
		end

		self._inStep = false
		local queued = self._afterStep
		if queued then
			self._afterStep = nil
			for _, fn in ipairs(queued) do
				local ok, err = pcall(fn)
				if not ok then Log.warn("[Part-Icles] deferred Disable failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
		end

		-- Single camera write per frame: summed shake offsets, delta-composed so the
		-- prior frame's offset removes cleanly (CameraShake/Apply.luau).
		CameraShakeApply.applyFrame()
		DistortionCanvas.applyFrame()
	end

	if RunService:IsClient() then
		-- Render phase AFTER camera (200) + character (300) scripts: camera/character-
		-- welded links read this frame's final pose instead of lagging one frame.
		-- Trade-off: links to physics-simulated parts read the prior simulation step.
		_bindSerial += 1
		self._renderStepName = "PartIclesEngine_" .. _instanceToken .. "_" .. _bindSerial
		local ok = pcall(function()
			RunService:BindToRenderStep(self._renderStepName, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, step)
		end)
		if ok then
			self.Connection = "RenderStep" -- truthy sentinel; consumers only truth-check
		else
			self._renderStepName = nil
			self.Connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(step)
		end
	else
		self.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
	end
end

-- Shut down the engine. Unbinds/disconnects the frame step, destroys every live clone, cancels
-- loops, restores animate sources, and clears texture pins. Safe to call multiple times.
function Particle:Deactivate()
	-- Bump engine-session generation FIRST. Any pending EnableEmit / Enable
	-- task.delay closure that captured the prior gen will now bail via
	-- genStillCurrent's `self._engineGen == engineGen` check, instead of
	-- spawning particles after teardown disconnected the Heartbeat.
	self._engineGen = (self._engineGen or 0) + 1
	if self.Connection then
		if self._renderStepName then
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(self._renderStepName) end)
			self._renderStepName = nil
		elseif typeof(self.Connection) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
			self.Connection:Disconnect()
		end
		self.Connection = nil
	end
	-- Disconnect UIS focus tracking  -  module reload would otherwise leak the two
	-- WindowFocused/WindowFocusReleased connections firing on dead-module closures.
	if self._focusConn then self._focusConn:Disconnect(); self._focusConn = nil end
	if self._blurConn then self._blurConn:Disconnect(); self._blurConn = nil end
	-- The step no longer runs; remove any applied camera-shake offset NOW or the
	-- camera stays tilted forever.
	CameraShakeApply.reset()
	DistortionCanvas.reset()
	if self._lingerByItem then table.clear(self._lingerByItem) end
	if self._evenCycleStore then table.clear(self._evenCycleStore) end
	-- Pending PartLife linger closures hold no engineGen guard, so they continue
	-- decrementing past Deactivate. Zero the counter here so a quick Off→On toggle
	-- doesn't see an inflated _lingerVisualCount restricting fresh emits via the cap
	-- check. The math.max(0, ... - 1) guard in the closure tolerates the reset.
	self._lingerVisualCount = 0
	-- Clean up all active particles. Skip live-RT animate pData (their VisualPart IS the source's
	-- RenderTemplate; _cancelAnimation below restores them instead).
	-- Flush pool BEFORE iterating ActiveEmits  -  pool entries are non-active clones we
	-- own; their Destroy is bookkeeping-light and short-circuits the workspace sweep
	-- below from finding them (the sweep matches on _PartIcleEmit attribute, which
	-- pooled entries still carry).
	Pool.flushAll()
	for i = #self.ActiveEmits, 1, -1 do
		local pData = self.ActiveEmits[i]
		local skip = self:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData)
		if not skip and pData.VisualPart then
			Pool.dropCloneMap(pData.VisualPart)
			pcall(function() pData.VisualPart:Destroy() end)
		end
		self:_reclaimPData(pData)
		self.ActiveEmits[i] = nil
	end
	-- Reset animate items via cancelAnimation (restores source RT to authored state).
	local animateKeys = {}
	for item in pairs(self.ActiveAnimates) do table.insert(animateKeys, item) end
	for _, item in ipairs(animateKeys) do
		pcall(function() self:_cancelAnimation(item) end)
	end
	table.clear(self.ActiveAnimates)
	for item, thread in pairs(self.ActiveLoops) do
		pcall(function() task.cancel(thread) end)
		self.ActiveLoops[item] = nil
	end
	-- Cancel chain-driven duration loops + clear buckets so the map doesn't sit
	-- pinned until module reload. `_engineGen` drift above also makes the threads
	-- self-terminate; this just frees the table refs.
	if self.ActiveChainLoops then for _, bucket in pairs(self.ActiveChainLoops) do for _, t in ipairs(bucket) do pcall(task.cancel, t) end end; table.clear(self.ActiveChainLoops) end
	VisualHost.reset()
	-- Sweep workspace + Lighting + the auto-managed CoreGui ScreenGui for any emitted items that
	-- escaped normal tracking (PointLights parent to original part; PartLife-delayed items removed
	-- from ActiveEmits early; screen effects live in Lighting; ImageLabels live in our ScreenHost).
	local function sweep(root) for _, desc in root:GetDescendants() do if desc:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then pcall(desc.Destroy, desc) end end end
	sweep(workspace); sweep(game:GetService("Lighting"))
	local ScreenHost = require(script.Parent.ScreenHost)
	if ScreenHost.exists() then sweep(ScreenHost.get()); ScreenHost.destroy() end
	local TexturePin = require(script.Parent.TexturePin)
	TexturePin.clear()
	-- Tear down Events compile cache: disconnects every Source/AncestryChanged signal +
	-- destroys every `_CompiledEventModule` clone so toggle-off-on cycles don't leak
	-- signal connections firing on dead-module closures.
	EventsMod.cleanup()
	-- LinkService owns an independent per-frame PreRender / Heartbeat connection +
	-- Anchored snapshot table. Deactivate disconnects + restores so toggle cycles
	-- don't leak link tracking or strand parts in Anchored=true state.
	if self.LinkService and self.LinkService.Deactivate then
		pcall(function() self.LinkService:Deactivate() end)
	end
end

-- Runtime folders live where VisualHost puts them: under workspace.CurrentCamera for a client or
-- the editor (local, out of Team Create replication and the place file), under Terrain on a server.
function Particle:GetFolder()
	return VisualHost.getFolder()
end

-- Idle-pool bucket. Pool.release re-parents released visuals here so authoring users can see
-- exactly which clones are recyclable vs. actively emitting (in the GetFolder bucket).
function Particle:GetPoolFolder()
	return VisualHost.getPoolFolder()
end

end

--[[
	EngineAttr  -  the single path for engine-originated writes on user-authored instances
	(source items, their PartIcleProperties config, raw ParticleEmitters / Trails / Beams).
	The plugin's selection listeners (SelectionHandler) skip repopulating when the changed value is
	the one the engine just wrote, so emission bookkeeping (Enabled windows, _emitGen, AnimateLoop,
	native gens) no longer rebuilds the Properties panel and resets the Resize / Retime / Hue sliders
	every emit cycle. Value matching, not a re-entrancy flag: Studio fires signals deferred, so the
	listener runs after the write returned.
	Invariant: runtime code never sets an attribute or Enabled on a user instance directly; it goes
	through EngineAttr.write / writeProp. Writes to emitted clones are exempt (nothing listens to them).
]]

local EngineAttr = {}

local NIL = {}
local _expected = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function remember(instance, name, value)
	local names = _expected[instance]
	if not names then
		names = {}
		_expected[instance] = names
	end
	if value == nil then value = NIL end
	names[name] = value
end

-- Attribute write. Returns pcall's ok flag.
function EngineAttr.write(instance, name, value)
	remember(instance, name, value)
	return pcall(instance.SetAttribute, instance, name, value)
end

-- Property write (native Enabled on ParticleEmitter / Trail / Beam).
function EngineAttr.writeProp(instance, prop, value)
	remember(instance, prop, value)
	return pcall(function() instance[prop] = value end)
end

-- True when the instance's current attribute value is the one the engine last wrote.
function EngineAttr.isEngineWrite(instance, name)
	local names = _expected[instance]
	if not names then return false end
	local expected = names[name]
	if expected == nil then return false end
	local current = instance:GetAttribute(name)
	if current == nil then return expected == NIL end
	return current == expected
end

-- Property variant for .Changed listeners.
function EngineAttr.isEngineProp(instance, prop)
	local names = _expected[instance]
	if not names then return false end
	local expected = names[prop]
	if expected == nil then return false end
	local ok, current = pcall(function() return instance[prop] end)
	return ok and current == expected
end

return EngineAttr

--[[
	EngineReplay Mixin  -  AnimateLoop cycle reset + replay, split from Engine.luau
	(500-line cap). Engine's death branch calls _replayAnimateCycle when the source
	item still has AnimateLoop=true; the body re-reads properties so live edits take
	effect each cycle, resets motion/collision/graph state, re-fires nested emits,
	and restarts the cycle clock. Caller keeps the pData in ActiveEmits.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local NestedEmitMod = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)

return function(Particle)

-- Reset every per-cycle field and replay one AnimateLoop cycle. Must mirror the
-- emit-time setup in the per-type Emit paths; Engine.luau is the only caller.
function Particle:_replayAnimateCycle(pData, currentTime)
	-- Reset and replay  -  re-read properties so live edits take effect.
	pData.StartTime = currentTime
	pData.CurrentStep = 0
	if pData.AccumulatedDT then pData.AccumulatedDT = 0 end
	if pData.InitialLocalCF then pData.LocalCF = pData.InitialLocalCF end
	if pData.AccRotX then pData.AccRotX = 0; pData.AccRotY = 0; pData.AccRotZ = 0 end
	-- Reset accumulated target-acceleration velocity so each loop iteration
	-- starts fresh from the base trajectory.
	if pData.TargetVel then pData.TargetVel = Vector3.zero end
	-- Reset OnHit Collision-mode state so each cycle replays from a clean
	-- slate (otherwise _collisionStopped / spin / SpeedMultiplier / reflected
	-- _accelVel compound across cycles). BaseDirection restored from the
	-- emit-time snapshot.
	pData._collisionStopped = false
	pData._spinRate = Vector3.zero
	pData._spinAccumX = 0
	pData._spinAccumY = 0
	pData._spinAccumZ = 0
	pData.SpeedMultiplier = 1
	if pData._accelVel then pData._accelVel = Vector3.zero end
	if pData._prevWorldOff then
		pData._prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero
		-- Drop OnHit-bounce mirror axes so each AnimateLoop cycle starts
		-- with un-mirrored trajectory state matching emit-time baseline.
		pData._displacementMirrorX = nil
		pData._displacementMirrorY = nil
		pData._displacementMirrorZ = nil
		-- Apply PosOffset(0) so cycle restart matches emit-time spawn pose
		-- (front-loaded curves would otherwise pop on the first step).
		if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs and pData.Graphs and pData.SpawnRotation then
			local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
			local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
			local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
			if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
				local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
					pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
				pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
				pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
				if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
					if pData.Type == "Model" then
						pcall(function() pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() + worldOff) end)
					else
						pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Stale-data fallback; the freshData path below re-rolls via Turbulence.buildInto.
	Turbulence.reprime(pData)
	if pData._initialBaseDirection then pData.BaseDirection = pData._initialBaseDirection end
	pData._lastOrientPos = nil
	-- Reset LinkTrack base (`_localWorldCF`) and overlay base (`_postUpdateCF`)
	-- so that on the first no-step frames of the new cycle, ApplyOrientation /
	-- ApplyZOffset compose against the replay's initial pose, not the last
	-- cycle's terminal pose.
	pData._localWorldCF, pData._postUpdateCF = pData.InitialLocalCF, pData.InitialLocalCF
	-- Clear GraphBlender state-search caches so next frame's monotonic-t search
	-- restarts from index 1. Otherwise the cached lastIdx points past the new
	-- t≈0, the search no-ops, and LerpGraph extrapolates with a negative alpha.
	pData._lastTransIdx = nil; pData._lastColorIdx = nil
	-- Stale-data fallback if freshData is nil. Fresh-data path overrides
	-- this AFTER the per-cycle refresh so the new Timescale + LifeTime apply.
	pData._effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(pData.Graphs and pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds and pData.Seeds.Timescale, pData.LifeTime)
	pData._hitHistory = nil
	if pData.Type == "ImageLabel" then pData.PosX = 0; pData.PosY = 0; pData.EnvVelX = 0; pData.EnvVelY = 0; pData.AccRot = 0 end
	local freshData = self:GetEmitData(pData.AnimateItem, pData._playOverrides and { Overrides = pData._playOverrides } or nil)
	if freshData then
		pData.Events = freshData.Events
		pData._killedManually = false
		pData._fireOnDeathOverride = false
		pData._hitFired = false
		pData.LifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Lifetime)
		if pData.LifeTime <= 0 then pData.LifeTime = 0.001 end
		pData.TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, freshData.TotalKeyFrames)
		if freshData.ParticleData then
			pData.Acceleration = freshData.ParticleData.Acceleration
			pData.Drag = freshData.ParticleData.Drag
			pData.HasDrag = freshData.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0
			pData.HasAccel = freshData.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0
		end
		-- Refresh cached flags that affect simulation behavior. Loop-restart honors
		-- live edits to AccelerationTowardsInstance / AccelTarget / InvertMotion.
		-- Target-accel is frame-granularity in branches 3/4 (one sample per
		-- Heartbeat) so it doesn't force NeedsFullIteration; only VelocityVectored
		-- does, because direction feedback requires per-step CFrame writes.
		pData.InvertMotion = freshData.InvertMotion or false
		pData.AccelTarget = freshData.AccelTarget
		pData.HasTargetAccel = freshData.AccelerationTowardsInstance == true and freshData.AccelTarget ~= nil and freshData.AccelStrength ~= nil and not pData.InvertMotion
		pData.TargetVel = Vector3.zero
		if freshData.VelocityVectored ~= nil then pData.VelocityVectored = freshData.VelocityVectored end
		pData.NeedsFullIteration = pData.VelocityVectored or false
		if freshData.RotMode then pData.RotMode = freshData.RotMode; pData.NeedsRotAccum = (freshData.RotMode == "Speed") and not (pData.VelocityVectored or false) end
		-- Refresh Link + LinkMode so a mid-loop LinkSource flip (None → Camera)
		-- takes effect on the next animate cycle. ReapplyLink reads pData.Link
		-- per frame, so updating it here is enough.
		-- Nested-driven pData keep their link (and a frozen frame if the parent already died).
		if not pData._nestedDriven then
			pData.Link = pData._playLink or freshData.Link
			pData._frozenLinkCF = nil
		end
		pData.LinkMode = freshData.LinkMode
		pData.LinkAxes = freshData.LinkAxes
		pData._linkMaskRefCF = nil
		if pData.Link then pData._linkGen = Pool.linkGen(pData.Link) end
		LinkCF.captureEmitFrame(pData)
		-- RigidLocal: re-snapshot the link's current pose so each new cycle
		-- locks to where the emitter is NOW, not where it was at first emit.
		if pData.Link and pData.Link.Parent then
			pData._rigidLocalParentCF = LinkCF.rigidWorldSnapshot(pData.LinkMode, pData.Link, pData._linkLocal, pData.LinkAxes, pData._linkMaskRefCF) or pData._rigidLocalParentCF
		end
		-- Refresh non-spatial setup fields via the per-type helpers. Spatial
		-- LocalCF rebuild (3D) and image-display refresh (2D) live in those helpers.
		if pData.Type == "ImageLabel" then
			self:_refreshImageLabelAnimateNonSpatial(pData, freshData)
		elseif pData.Type == "Lightning" then
			-- Also nils pData.Link (the generic assignment above set it).
			self:_refreshLightningAnimate(pData, freshData)
		elseif pData.Type == "CameraShake" then
			-- No VisualPart; the generic non-spatial refresh would index it.
			self:_refreshCameraShakeAnimate(pData, freshData)
		elseif pData.Type == "Rocks" then
			self:_refreshRocksAnimate(pData, freshData)
		elseif pData.Type == "Rope" then
			-- Pose-preserving: point buffers survive unless the chain layout changed.
			self:_refreshRopeAnimate(pData, freshData)
		elseif pData.Type == "Distortion" then
			-- No VisualPart; per-kind phase policy (Noise/Wave continuous, Ripple restarts).
			self:_refreshDistortionAnimate(pData, freshData)
		else
			self:_refreshAnimateNonSpatial(pData, freshData)
		end
		-- Restore any graphs the prior cycle's StaticPass nil'd so refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds'
		-- pairs(pData.Graphs) iteration picks them up. Static-pass at end of block
		-- re-detects + re-nils as appropriate.
		StaticPass.restoreFromFreshData(pData, freshData)
		AxisLinksMod.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds(pData, freshData, GraphMod)
		-- Re-read Turbulence per cycle (0→nonzero edits take effect). Non-invert
		-- items re-roll the noise seed each cycle; InvertMotion items keep the
		-- Seeds._turbSeed the pre-sim rolled so the rebuilt cache stays in sync.
		if pData.Type == "Part" or pData.Type == "Attachment" or pData.Type == "Model" then
			Turbulence.buildInto(pData, freshData)
		end
		-- Re-detect static graphs from fresh pData.Graphs. Idempotent: clears
		-- stale _static<Name> fields so a graph switched from static→dynamic mid-
		-- cycle re-arms the per-frame sample path. ImageLabel SizeScale both-axes-
		-- static collapse mirrored from buildImageLabelPData so the per-frame Size
		-- block short-circuits (frame-0 wrote the constant Size).
		StaticPass.apply(pData)
		if pData.Type == "ImageLabel"
			and pData._staticSizeScaleX and pData._staticSizeScaleY then
			pData._staticSizeScaleX = nil
			pData._staticSizeScaleY = nil
		end
		-- Must run after fresh Timescale graph + LifeTime are in place.
		pData._effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(pData.Graphs and pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds and pData.Seeds.Timescale, pData.LifeTime)
		-- Distortion phase reseed reads the recompute above (Distortion/init.luau).
		if pData.Type == "Distortion" then
			self:_reseedDistortionPhase(pData)
		end
		-- ImageLabel InvertMotion: re-seed end-state for next cycle (mirrors the
		-- emit-time setup in buildImageLabelPData) so each cycle integrates from
		-- the inverted end-pose with negative dt.
		if pData.Type == "ImageLabel" then
			-- ImgInvertMotion lives under its raw attribute name (GetData reads it
			-- directly, no TypeRegistry attrName mapping into freshData.InvertMotion).
			pData.InvertMotion = freshData.ImgInvertMotion or false
			if pData.InvertMotion then
				local endX, endY, endVelX, endVelY = self:_computeImageLabelEndState(freshData, pData.DirX or 0, pData.DirY or 0, pData.LifeTime, pData.Seeds)
				pData.PosX, pData.PosY = endX, endY
				pData.EnvVelX, pData.EnvVelY = endVelX, endVelY
				pData._effectiveElapsed = pData.LifeTime
				pData._invertDtSign = -1
			else
				pData._invertDtSign = nil
			end
		end
		-- Rebuild SimLocalCFrames whenever InvertMotion is true. Loop restart
		-- can land on a different InvertMotion / TotalKeyFrames than the last
		-- cycle, and inverted UpdatePart indexes the cache by step. Drop the
		-- cache on InvertMotion=false so a later flip-on triggers a fresh build.
		if pData.InvertMotion and pData.AnimateItem and pData.AnimateItem.Parent then
			local restartCF
			local isAttachment = pData.Type == "Attachment"
			if pData.Type == "Model" then
				local ok, cf = pcall(function() return pData.AnimateItem:GetPivot() end)
				if ok then restartCF = cf end
			elseif isAttachment then
				-- Parent-local; matches EmitAnimate's `localCF = attachment.CFrame`.
				restartCF = pData.AnimateItem.CFrame
			elseif pData.AnimateItem:IsA("BasePart") then
				restartCF = pData.AnimateItem.CFrame
			end
			if restartCF then
				local ok2, sim, effTKF = pcall(function()
					if isAttachment then
						return self:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(freshData, pData.Seeds, restartCF, pData.BaseDirection, pData.SpreadRotation, pData.LifeTime, nil, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
					else
						return self:PreSimulateForward(freshData, pData.Seeds, restartCF, pData.BaseDirection, pData.SpreadRotation, pData.Link, pData.LifeTime, nil, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation, pData._linkLocal)
					end
				end)
				if ok2 then
					pData.SimLocalCFrames = sim
					if effTKF then pData.TotalKeyFrames = effTKF end
				end
			end
		elseif not pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.SimLocalCFrames = nil
		end
		-- Beam: rebuild AnimatedProps + GraphBlender states from fresh data. Also
		-- refresh cached _baseWidth0/Width1/CurveSize0/CurveSize1/TextureLength/
		-- Segments from the source's CURRENT values so live edits to non-animated
		-- graph props propagate into the next animate-loop iteration.
		if pData.Type == "Beam" and freshData.BeamProps then
			local vb = pData.VisualPart
			local ap = {}
			for name, sequence in pairs(freshData.BeamProps) do
				if sequence then
					if GraphMod.IsStatic(sequence) then
						if vb then vb[name] = GraphMod.GetStaticValue(sequence, vb[name]) end
					else ap[name] = { Sequence = sequence, Seed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(sequence) } end
				end
			end
			pData.AnimatedProps = ap
			if vb then
				pData._baseWidth0 = vb.Width0
				pData._baseWidth1 = vb.Width1
				pData._baseCurveSize0 = vb.CurveSize0
				pData._baseCurveSize1 = vb.CurveSize1
				pData._baseTextureLength = vb.TextureLength
				pData._baseSegments = vb.Segments
			end
			if ap.TextureSpeed and vb then vb.TextureSpeed = 0 end
			if freshData.GraphBlender then
				local ts, cs = GraphMod.CollectGraphStates(freshData.GraphBlender)
				pData.TransStates = ts; pData.ColorStates = cs
				local tmt = {}; for idx = 1, #ts - 1 do tmt[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedTimes(ts[idx].Graph, ts[idx+1].Graph) end
				local cmt = {}; for idx = 1, #cs - 1 do cmt[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(cs[idx].Graph, cs[idx+1].Graph) end
				pData.TransMergedTimes = tmt; pData.ColorMergedTimes = cmt
				if #ts > 0 and vb then vb.Transparency = ts[1].Graph end
				if #cs > 0 and vb then vb.Color = cs[1].Graph end
			end
		end
		if freshData.PLRange then pData.PLRange = freshData.PLRange end
		if freshData.PLBrightness then pData.PLBrightness = freshData.PLBrightness end
		if freshData.PLColor then pData.PLColor = freshData.PLColor end
	end
	-- Animate-loop replay reset target: read source's CURRENT CFrame each cycle so
	-- parent moves carry through (cached InitialAnchorCF would freeze at emit-time pose).
	-- Lightning / Rocks / CameraShake / Rope skipped: their VisualPart is a rig Model or
	-- nil (the un-pcall'd BasePart-source write below would error) and their per-type
	-- refresh already re-rolled from the source's current pose.
	if pData.Type ~= "Lightning" and pData.Type ~= "Rocks" and pData.Type ~= "CameraShake" and pData.Type ~= "Rope" and pData.Type ~= "Distortion"
		and pData.AnimateItem and pData.AnimateItem.Parent and pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
		if pData.Type == "Model" then
			local ok, sourceCF = pcall(function() return pData.AnimateItem:GetPivot() end)
			if ok and sourceCF then pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(sourceCF) end
		elseif pData.AnimateItem:IsA("BasePart") then
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.AnimateItem.CFrame
		elseif pData.AnimateItem:IsA("Attachment") then
			-- RT is a CHILD of the source Attachment; identity preserves the
			-- parent-local invariant established by Transform.luau:96. Writing
			-- source.CFrame here bakes the source's own offset INTO the RT.
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		end
	end
	-- Nested re-emit on AnimateLoop cycle restart. Per-iteration re-fire is required because
	-- nested children's emit cycle is finite (EmissionMode=Emit) or replaces its pData
	-- (EmissionMode=Animate). Nested-driven, so _emitGen is bypassed and prior cycles' nested
	-- closures keep flying (the parent's _nestedAlive stays true across cycles).
	if pData.AnimateItem and pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
		-- Rebuild the ctx so cycle 2+ children stay in the same chain and play as cycle 1.
		local replayCtx = { ChainCtx = pData.EventChainCtx, _playToken = pData._playToken }
		if pData.Type == "Lightning" or pData.Type == "Rocks" or pData.Type == "Rope" then
			-- Rig clones strip Transformed children (copyBare); nested emitters live
			-- in the SOURCE RT and fire against the rig Model as link.
			local freshLn = self:GetData(pData.AnimateItem)
			if freshLn and freshLn.RenderTemplate then
				NestedEmitMod.walk(self, freshLn.RenderTemplate, pData.VisualPart, pData._nestedAlive, replayCtx, pData._scaleNode or pData.ParentScale)
			end
		elseif pData.Type == "Part" or pData.Type == "Attachment" or pData.Type == "Model" then
			-- Live RT is both source and link; pruned, nested-driven like the first cycle.
			NestedEmitMod.walk(self, pData.VisualPart, pData.VisualPart, pData._nestedAlive, replayCtx, pData._scaleNode or pData.ParentScale)
		end
	end
	self:_fireAnimateCycleRestartEvents(pData)
end

-- AnimateLoop refresh of non-spatial fields. Spatial state stays (full rebuild is per-type).
function Particle:_refreshAnimateNonSpatial(pData, freshData)
	if not freshData then return end
	if freshData.EmissionDirection then pData.EmissionDirection = freshData.EmissionDirection end
	if freshData.Orientation then pData.Orientation = freshData.Orientation end
	if freshData.ZOffset ~= nil then pData.ZOffset = freshData.ZOffset end
	if freshData.RotOrder then pData.RotOrder = freshData.RotOrder end
	if freshData.PartLife ~= nil then pData.PartLife = freshData.PartLife end
	DecalLayersMod.refresh(pData, freshData)
	MeshFramesMod.refresh(pData, freshData)
	-- Timescale attrName variants per type; exactly one is set.
	local tsG = freshData.Timescale or freshData.BeamTimescale or freshData.AtmTimescale or freshData.PLTimescale
	if tsG and pData.Graphs then pData.Graphs.Timescale = tsG; pData.Seeds.Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(tsG) end
	if freshData.ParticleData and freshData.ParticleData.SpreadAngle then
		local sa = freshData.ParticleData.SpreadAngle
		local rx, ry = 0, 0
		if sa.X > 0 or sa.Y > 0 then
			rx = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sa.X
			ry = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sa.Y
		end
		pData.SpreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx), math.rad(ry), 0)
	end
end

end

--[[
	EvenCycle  -  rolling-cycle math for rate-mode EvenDistribution sampling.
	Per-property cycle length sampled from a NumberRange attribute at every cycle
	wrap. Sign of N drives direction: positive = forward (idx walks 1..|N|), negative
	= reverse (|N|..1). 0 or default zero-range falls back to current cfg.Rate (forward).
]]

local EvenCycle = {}
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)

-- Sample N from a NumberRange cycle attribute stored on the PartIcleProperties
-- Configuration child. Sign-preserving floor to integer.
function EvenCycle.resolve(config, attrName, fallbackRate)
	local r = config and config:GetAttribute(attrName)
	if typeof(r) ~= "NumberRange" or (r.Min == 0 and r.Max == 0) then
		return math.max(1, math.floor(fallbackRate or 12))
	end
	local n = r.Min + (r.Max - r.Min) * math.random()
	n = math.floor(n + (n >= 0 and 0.5 or -0.5))
	if n == 0 then return math.max(1, math.floor(fallbackRate or 12)) end
	return n
end

-- One step of a per-property cycle. On cycle wrap (or first step), re-samples
-- signedN + seeds idx at 1 (forward) or |N| (reverse). Returns (idx, signedN, absN).
function EvenCycle.step(idx, signedN, config, attrName, fallbackRate)
	local absN = math.abs(signedN)
	local function reroll()
		signedN = EvenCycle.resolve(config, attrName, fallbackRate)
		absN = math.abs(signedN)
		if signedN > 0 then idx = 1 else idx = absN end
	end
	if absN == 0 or idx == 0 then
		reroll()
	elseif signedN > 0 then
		idx = idx + 1
		if idx > absN then reroll() end
	else
		idx = idx - 1
		if idx < 1 then reroll() end
	end
	return idx, signedN, absN
end

-- Whether Position / Rotation EvenDistribution is on (PartIcleProperties config flags).
function EvenCycle.evenFlags(config)
	if not config then return false, false end
	local hasPos = (config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") or config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") or config:GetAttribute("PosZEven")) == true
	local hasRot = (config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") or config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") or config:GetAttribute("RotZEven")) == true
	return hasPos, hasRot
end

-- Persistent per-emitter stepping. `store` is a table keyed by a stable emitter id
-- (one slot per authored emitter, shared by all its clones) holding
-- {posIdx, posSignedN, rotIdx, rotSignedN}. Steps each enabled axis once and writes
-- the advanced state back, so discrete bursts and nested re-emits roll the same cycle
-- the continuous loop does. The slot table allocates once per key (first emission);
-- steady-state reuses it in place (zero-alloc hot loop).
function EvenCycle.advance(store, key, config, currentRate, hasPosEven, hasRotEven)
	local slot = store[key]
	if not slot then
		slot = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
		store[key] = slot
	end
	local posIdx, posAbs, rotIdx, rotAbs = 0, 0, 0, 0
	-- Only roll (offset) when the cycle is EXPLICITLY set; unset = plain even spread.
	if hasPosEven and EvenCycle.isSet(config, "PositionEvenCycle") then
		slot[1], slot[2], posAbs = EvenCycle.step(slot[1], slot[2], config, "PositionEvenCycle", currentRate)
		posIdx = slot[1]
	end
	if hasRotEven and EvenCycle.isSet(config, "RotationEvenCycle") then
		slot[3], slot[4], rotAbs = EvenCycle.step(slot[3], slot[4], config, "RotationEvenCycle", currentRate)
		rotIdx = slot[3]
	end
	return posIdx, posAbs, rotIdx, rotAbs
end

-- True only when the cycle NumberRange attribute is present and non-zero (user set it).
function EvenCycle.isSet(config, attrName)
	local r = config and config:GetAttribute(attrName)
	return typeof(r) == "NumberRange" and not (r.Min == 0 and r.Max == 0)
end

-- Drop a key's cycle state so the next emission restarts at idx 1. Called on full stop.
function EvenCycle.clear(store, key)
	if store and key ~= nil then
		store[key] = nil
	end
end

-- Backfill `_EvenCycleId` for emitters transformed before the id existed: stamp the
-- authored item + any Transformed descendant of its RenderTemplate (the nested
-- emitters that get cloned), so their clones inherit a shared id. No-op once stamped.
-- New transforms get the id at Transform time; this only catches pre-existing saves.
function EvenCycle.ensureIds(item)
	if item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") then return end
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
	EngineAttr.write(item, "_EvenCycleId", HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	for _, desc in ipairs(rt:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") and not desc:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") then
			EngineAttr.write(desc, "_EvenCycleId", HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))
		end
	end
end

return EvenCycle

--[[
	Events  -  Part-Icles runtime; helper module (not a mixin).
	  - Compile cache for per-event Modules (clone-and-require, invalidates on Source change).
	  - ChainCtx (ChainId + Depth) propagation; per-event ChainDepthLimit + hard ceiling.
	  - Per-frame burst cap + once-per-second drop reporting.
	  - Payload builder, world-pos/CFrame helpers, Events.fire dispatcher.
	  - emitTargetInstance (EmitTarget.luau): EmitTarget + EmitMode → in place / origin override / fan-out.
	  - afterUpdate: per-frame OnHit raycast.

	Cross-file invariants:
	  - pData.Events is FROZEN at emit (EventsSchema.readEnabled snapshot); hot path never re-reads.
	  - pData.EventChainCtx propagates through _registerEmit + every event fire.
	  - Plugin teardown MUST call Events.cleanup() to release Module connections.
	  - Events.compile refuses every Module in plugin context unless the gate from Modules/ScriptTrust approves.
	  - Sibling mixins: EmitTarget.luau (emitTargetInstance), Hit.luau (afterUpdate).
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local EventsPayload = require(script.Parent.EventsPayload)
local HitFilter = require(script.Parent.HitFilter)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

local Events = {}

local MAX_EVENT_FIRES_PER_FRAME = 256
local DEFAULT_CHAIN_DEPTH_LIMIT = 4
local HARD_CHAIN_DEPTH_CEILING  = 32
Events.DEFAULT_CHAIN_DEPTH_LIMIT = DEFAULT_CHAIN_DEPTH_LIMIT
local CONFIG_NAME = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME
local EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME = "Events"

-- Per-Module compile cache; key = source ModuleScript. _invalidate clears entries.
local cache = {}

-- Per-frame burst state.
Events._frameCount = 0
Events._burstDropped = 0
Events._burstReportPending = false

local _depthDropPending = false
local _depthDropped = 0

-- Bumped by cleanup() so stale 1s-delay warn closures bail.
local _reportGeneration = 0

-- Warn-once sentinels for emit-mode mismatches.
local _unsupportedOriginWarned = {}
local _nilOriginWarned = {}
Events._unsupportedOriginWarned = _unsupportedOriginWarned
Events._nilOriginWarned = _nilOriginWarned

local _nextChainId = 0
local function nextChainId()
	_nextChainId += 1
	return _nextChainId
end

function Events.newChainCtx()
	return { ChainId = nextChainId(), Depth = 0 }
end

-- Shallow copy emitCtx + EmitIndex (1-based) for burst-loop clones.
function Events.withEmitIndex(emitCtx, i)
	if not emitCtx then return { EmitIndex = i } end
	local out = { EmitIndex = i }
	for k, v in pairs(emitCtx) do
		if k ~= "EmitIndex" then out[k] = v end
	end
	return out
end

-- Shallow copy + EmitIndex + EmitCount; required pair for EvenDistribution sampler.
function Events.withEmitIndexAndCount(emitCtx, i, n)
	if not emitCtx then return { EmitIndex = i, EmitCount = n } end
	local out = { EmitIndex = i, EmitCount = n }
	for k, v in pairs(emitCtx) do
		if k ~= "EmitIndex" and k ~= "EmitCount" then out[k] = v end
	end
	return out
end

-- Shallow copy + within-burst index (i/count) AND a per-emission EvenDistribution
-- rolling-cycle OFFSET (posIdx/posN, rotIdx/rotN, per property). The sampler keeps the
-- i/count even spread unchanged and ADDS the offset (gap/N step) on top, so each emission
-- shifts the whole pattern. posN/rotN are absolute cycle lengths (0 = no offset). Direction
-- (forward/reverse) is already baked into the supplied idx.
function Events.withEvenOffset(emitCtx, i, count, posIdx, posN, rotIdx, rotN)
	local out = { EmitIndex = i, EmitCount = count }
	if emitCtx then
		for k, v in pairs(emitCtx) do
			if k ~= "EmitIndex" and k ~= "EmitCount"
				and k ~= "EvenOffsetIdx_Pos" and k ~= "EvenOffsetN_Pos"
				and k ~= "EvenOffsetIdx_Rot" and k ~= "EvenOffsetN_Rot" then
				out[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	if posN and posN > 0 then
		out.EvenOffsetIdx_Pos = posIdx
		out.EvenOffsetN_Pos = posN
	end
	if rotN and rotN > 0 then
		out.EvenOffsetIdx_Rot = rotIdx
		out.EvenOffsetN_Rot = rotN
	end
	return out
end

-- Strip origin-override fields when threading emitCtx into a chained sub-emit;
-- preserves ChainCtx + EmitIndex/EmitCount. Used by Events chain dispatches.
function Events.descendCtx(emitCtx)
	if not emitCtx then return nil end
	if emitCtx.EventOriginCF == nil and emitCtx.IgnoreLink == nil
		and emitCtx.UseFullOrigin == nil and emitCtx.EventOriginResolver == nil then
		return emitCtx
	end
	return {
		ChainCtx  = emitCtx.ChainCtx,
		EmitIndex = emitCtx.EmitIndex,
		EmitCount = emitCtx.EmitCount,
	}
end

-- Compile / cache

-- Plugin context allows Source reads; play / non-plugin lacks PluginOrOpenCloud capability.
-- Play mode: skip clone+require (Source immutable anyway, direct require works).
local _isPluginContext = pcall(function() return (Instance.new("ModuleScript")).Source end)

-- Event Modules run with the caller's permissions, so plugin context runs one only when the
-- installed gate approves it; with no gate every Module is refused. Game runtime is not gated.
-- Producer of the gate: Modules/ScriptTrust (per-place approval).
local _scriptGate = nil
local _noGateWarned = false

function Events.setScriptGate(gate)
	_scriptGate = gate
end

function Events.scriptAllowed(moduleScript)
	if not _isPluginContext then return true end
	if _scriptGate then return _scriptGate(moduleScript) == true end
	if not _noGateWarned then
		_noGateWarned = true
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Events] event scripts do not run in Studio edit mode outside the Part-Icles plugin")
	end
	return false
end

function Events._compile(moduleScript)
	if not _isPluginContext then
		local ok, fn = pcall(require, moduleScript)
		if not ok then return nil, fn elseif type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil, "module must return function(payload)" end
		return fn, nil, nil
	end
	local clone = moduleScript:Clone()
	clone.Name = "_CompiledEventModule"
	clone.Archivable = false
	clone.Parent = moduleScript.Parent
	local ok, fn = pcall(require, clone)
	if not ok then
		clone:Destroy()
		return nil, fn
	end
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		clone:Destroy()
		return nil, "module must return function(payload)"
	end
	return fn, nil, clone
end

function Events._isCacheValid(cacheEntry, moduleScript)
	if not cacheEntry or not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then return false end
	if moduleScript.Name ~= "Module" then return false end
	local eventCfg = cacheEntry.expectedEventCfg
	if not eventCfg or not eventCfg.Parent then return false end
	if eventCfg.Name ~= cacheEntry.expectedEventName then return false end
	if not eventCfg.Parent or eventCfg.Parent.Name ~= EVENTS_FOLDER_NAME then return false end
	return moduleScript.Parent == eventCfg
end

-- Single chokepoint to release signals + destroy clone + drop cache entry.
function Events._invalidate(moduleScript)
	local entry = cache[moduleScript]
	if not entry then return end
	if entry.sourceConn then entry.sourceConn:Disconnect(); entry.sourceConn = nil end
	if entry.ancestryConn then entry.ancestryConn:Disconnect(); entry.ancestryConn = nil end
	if entry.nameConn then entry.nameConn:Disconnect(); entry.nameConn = nil end
	if entry.compiledClone then
		pcall(function() entry.compiledClone:Destroy() end)
		entry.compiledClone = nil
	end
	cache[moduleScript] = nil
end

-- Get-or-compile; recompiles on dirty (Source changed) or tree-position mismatch.
function Events.compile(moduleScript)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
	if not Events.scriptAllowed(moduleScript) then return nil end
	local entry = cache[moduleScript]
	if entry and not entry.dirty and Events._isCacheValid(entry, moduleScript) then
		return entry.fn
	end
	-- Stale entry: invalidate first so signals don't double-fire on the new entry.
	if entry then Events._invalidate(moduleScript) end

	local fn, err, clone = Events._compile(moduleScript)
	if not fn then
		Events.reportScriptError(moduleScript, err)
		return nil
	end

	local eventCfg = moduleScript.Parent
	if not eventCfg or not eventCfg:IsA("Configuration") then
		clone:Destroy()
		return nil
	end

	local newEntry = {
		fn = fn,
		expectedEventCfg = eventCfg,
		expectedEventName = eventCfg.Name,
		dirty = false,
		compiledClone = clone,
	}
	-- Mark dirty on Source-change; recompile lazily on next fire. Play / non-plugin contexts
	-- lack the PluginOrOpenCloud capability and Source is immutable there anyway  -  skip.
	if _isPluginContext then
		newEntry.sourceConn = moduleScript:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Source"):Connect(function()
			if cache[moduleScript] then cache[moduleScript].dirty = true end
		end)
	end
	-- Module dragged out / destroyed → invalidate.
	newEntry.ancestryConn = moduleScript.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not Events._isCacheValid(cache[moduleScript], moduleScript) then
			Events._invalidate(moduleScript)
		end
	end)
	-- Snap user-renames back to "Module" so the cache-validity check doesn't
	-- treat every fire as stale and trigger a clone+require+destroy cycle.
	newEntry.nameConn = moduleScript:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function()
		if moduleScript.Name ~= "Module" then
			pcall(function() moduleScript.Name = "Module" end)
		end
	end)
	cache[moduleScript] = newEntry
	return fn
end

function Events.cleanup()
	-- Snapshot keys first; mutating during pairs() is undefined.
	local keys = {}
	for moduleScript in pairs(cache) do table.insert(keys, moduleScript) end
	for _, moduleScript in ipairs(keys) do Events._invalidate(moduleScript) end
	-- Bump report gen so in-flight task.delay warn closures bail.
	_reportGeneration += 1
	Events._frameCount = 0
	Events._burstDropped = 0
	Events._burstReportPending = false
	_depthDropped = 0
	_depthDropPending = false
	table.clear(_unsupportedOriginWarned)
	table.clear(_nilOriginWarned)
end

-- Burst cap + reporting

-- Once-per-second summary; per-frame would flood Output at 60fps overflow.
function Events._reportBurst()
	Events._burstDropped += 1
	if not Events._burstReportPending then
		Events._burstReportPending = true
		local gen = _reportGeneration
		task.delay(1, function()
			if gen ~= _reportGeneration then return end
			if Events._burstDropped > 0 then
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Events] dropped %d event fires this second."):format(Events._burstDropped))
			end
			Events._burstDropped = 0
			Events._burstReportPending = false
		end)
	end
end

function Events.reserveFrameFire()
	if Events._frameCount >= MAX_EVENT_FIRES_PER_FRAME then
		Events._reportBurst()
		return false
	end
	Events._frameCount += 1
	return true
end

-- Called once per Heartbeat to reset the per-frame counter.
function Events.tickFrame()
	Events._frameCount = 0
end

function Events.dropDepth(eventName)
	_depthDropped += 1
	if not _depthDropPending then
		_depthDropPending = true
		local gen = _reportGeneration
		task.delay(1, function()
			if gen ~= _reportGeneration then return end
			if _depthDropped > 0 then
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Events] dropped %d event fire(s) this second (chain depth limit reached%s)."):format(
					_depthDropped, eventName and (" on " .. eventName) or ""))
			end
			_depthDropped = 0
			_depthDropPending = false
		end)
	end
end

function Events.reportScriptError(moduleScript, err)
	local path = moduleScript and moduleScript:GetFullName() or "<destroyed>"
	Log.warn(("[Part-Icles Events] %s\n  %s"):format(path, tostring(err)))
end

-- World-position helpers (type-correct across Attachment/Model/Beam/PL/Screen).
function Events.getWorldCF(pData)
	-- VisualPart-less types first. EventsSchema.VALID_PER_TYPE offers OnDestruction only for
	-- types with a branch here (Lifecycle._fireOnDestruction gates on this returning non-nil).
	if pData.Type == "Distortion" then
		if pData._lastOriginPos then return CFrame.new(pData._lastOriginPos) end
		return Events.getSourceWorldCF(pData._sourceItem)
	end
	if pData.Type == "CameraShake" then
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		return cam and cam.CFrame or nil
	end
	local v = pData.VisualPart
	if not v or not v.Parent then return nil end
	if v:IsA("BasePart") then return v.CFrame end
	if v:IsA("Attachment") then return v.WorldCFrame end
	if v:IsA("Model") then return v:GetPivot() end
	if v:IsA("Light") or v:IsA("Sound") then
		local p = v.Parent
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p.CFrame end
		if p and p:IsA("Attachment") then return p.WorldCFrame end
		return nil
	end
	if v:IsA("Beam") then
		local a0 = v.Attachment0
		if a0 then
			local a1 = v.Attachment1
			if a1 then return CFrame.new((a0.WorldPosition + a1.WorldPosition) * 0.5) end
			return CFrame.new(a0.WorldPosition)
		end
		return nil
	end
	return nil
end

function Events.getWorldPosition(pData)
	local cf = Events.getWorldCF(pData)
	return cf and cf.Position or nil
end

function Events.getSourceWorldCF(sourceItem)
	if not sourceItem or not sourceItem.Parent then return nil end
	if sourceItem:IsA("BasePart") then return sourceItem.CFrame end
	if sourceItem:IsA("Attachment") then return sourceItem.WorldCFrame end
	if sourceItem:IsA("Model") then return sourceItem:GetPivot() end
	if sourceItem:IsA("Beam") then
		local a0 = sourceItem.Attachment0
		if a0 then
			local a1 = sourceItem.Attachment1
			if a1 then return CFrame.new((a0.WorldPosition + a1.WorldPosition) * 0.5) end
			return CFrame.new(a0.WorldPosition)
		end
		return nil
	end
	if sourceItem:IsA("Light") or sourceItem:IsA("Sound") then
		local p = sourceItem.Parent
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p.CFrame end
		if p and p:IsA("Attachment") then return p.WorldCFrame end
		return nil
	end
	return nil
end

-- ============================================================================
-- OnHit raycast filter
-- ============================================================================

-- Explicit table.insert because Lua's `{a, nil, b}` literal is sparse; would drop
-- whichever entry is nil and silently shift the rest, omitting later filters.
function Events.makeHitParams(pData)
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local filter = {}
	if pData.VisualPart then table.insert(filter, pData.VisualPart) end
	if pData._sourceItem then table.insert(filter, pData._sourceItem) end
	if pData._sourceItem then
		local rt = pData._sourceItem:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
		if rt then table.insert(filter, rt) end
		-- EmitParent ObjectValue: filter the picked anchor + its descendants so the
		-- first afterUpdate raycast doesn't fire OnHit on the user's emission anchor.
		local ep = pData._sourceItem:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
		if ep and ep:IsA("ObjectValue") and ep.Value then
			table.insert(filter, ep.Value)
		end
	end
	-- Attachments self-hit on first ray without filtering parent BasePart.
	if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart:IsA("Attachment") and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
		table.insert(filter, pData.VisualPart.Parent)
	end
	-- Type-level filter shared with Rocks and Lightning Seek (HitFilter.luau). Read once at
	-- emit time so mid-session edits apply to the next emit cycle.
	if pData._sourceItem then
		local group, excludes = HitFilter.read(pData._sourceItem)
		if group ~= "" then
			-- The group may have been deleted in the collision editor since it was picked.
			pcall(function() p.CollisionGroup = group end)
		end
		for _, inst in ipairs(excludes) do table.insert(filter, inst) end
	end
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
	p.IgnoreWater = true
	return p
end

-- Payload builder. Thin wrapper; per-event field population lives in EventsPayload.build.
function Events.makePayload(particle, pData, eventName, emitCtx)
	return EventsPayload.build(pData, eventName, emitCtx, Events.getWorldCF(pData))
end

-- EmitMode + dispatch

-- Push OnHit spawn off the hit surface along its normal so the emitted particle's first
-- raycast doesn't immediately re-fire OnHit on the same surface.
local ONHIT_SPAWN_NORMAL_OFFSET = 0.1

-- Resolve origin CF for non-AtTarget modes (AtPosition / AtSource / AtCFrame).
-- OnEmit uses LIVE source position so EmitDelay-gapped emits track movement.
-- OnHit: offset along payload.HitNormal so spawn is just outside the surface.
function Events.resolveEmitModeCF(mode, payload, pData)
	if mode == "AtPosition" then
		if payload and payload._eventName == "OnEmit" then
			local cf = Events.getWorldCF(pData)
			if cf then return cf end
			-- Source destroyed mid-EmitDelay; fall back to last-frame CurrentPosition.
			if pData.CurrentPosition then return CFrame.new(pData.CurrentPosition) end
		end
		local pos = payload.HitPosition or payload.DeathPosition or payload.EmitPosition
		if pos and payload._eventName == "OnHit" and payload.HitNormal then
			pos = pos + payload.HitNormal * ONHIT_SPAWN_NORMAL_OFFSET
		end
		return pos and CFrame.new(pos) or nil
	elseif mode == "AtSource" then
		return Events.getSourceWorldCF(pData._sourceItem)
	elseif mode == "AtCFrame" then
		if payload and payload._eventName == "OnEmit" then
			local cf = Events.getWorldCF(pData)
			if cf then return cf end
		end
		local cf = payload and payload.WorldCFrame
		if cf and payload._eventName == "OnHit" and payload.HitNormal then
			cf = cf + payload.HitNormal * ONHIT_SPAWN_NORMAL_OFFSET
		end
		return cf or nil
	end
	return nil
end

-- Fire dispatcher

function Events.fire(particle, pData, eventName, chainCtx, payload)
	chainCtx = chainCtx or Events.newChainCtx()
	local cfg = pData.Events and pData.Events[eventName]
	-- Enabled gate first; disabled events don't burn depth budget or warn.
	if not cfg or not cfg.Enabled then return end

	-- Two depth checks: fire-side (this event) and _emitTransformed-side (downstream fan-out).
	local depthLimit = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.ChainDepthLimit) or DEFAULT_CHAIN_DEPTH_LIMIT), 1, HARD_CHAIN_DEPTH_CEILING)
	if chainCtx.Depth >= depthLimit then
		Events.dropDepth(eventName)
		return
	end

	-- Nothing wired → no dispatch.
	if not cfg.EmitTarget and not cfg.Module then return end

	-- Backfill payload first so payload.X writes below don't nil-index.
	if not payload then
		payload = Events.makePayload(particle, pData, eventName, nil)
	end
	payload._eventName = payload._eventName or eventName

	-- Burst cap after config check.
	if not Events.reserveFrameFire() then return end

	payload.Source = payload.Source or pData._sourceItem
	payload.Particle = payload.Particle or pData.VisualPart
	payload.RenderTemplate = payload.RenderTemplate or payload.Particle

	-- Inject helpers only when Module runs (avoid closure alloc for EmitTarget-only events).
	if cfg.Module then
		payload.Emit = function(target, mode)
			Events.emitTargetInstance(particle, target, mode or cfg.EmitMode, payload, pData, chainCtx, depthLimit)
		end
		payload.Kill = function()
			if particle._killParticle then
				particle:_killParticle(pData, { fireOnDeath = false })
			end
		end
		-- Setters auto-flip the matching skip flag so per-frame graph writes don't clobber the override.
		EventsPayload.attachSkipSetters(payload, pData)
		payload.SetColor = function(color) EventsPayload.applyColor(pData, color) end
		payload.SetTransparency = function(amount) EventsPayload.applyTransparency(pData, amount) end
		payload.Teleport = function(cf) EventsPayload.applyTeleport(pData, cf) end
		EventsPayload.attachAdvancedSetters(payload, pData)
		payload.SetSpeedMultiplier = function(scalar)
			if type(scalar) == "number" then pData.SpeedMultiplier = scalar end
		end
		-- New total LifeTime in seconds. Clamped to 0.001 to avoid div-by-zero in
		-- the real_i (currentTime - StartTime) / LifeTime computation.
		payload.SetLifetime = function(seconds)
			if type(seconds) == "number" then pData.LifeTime = math.max(0.001, seconds) end
		end
	end

	-- Active-particle cap: skip cfg.EmitTarget when at cap, but always run Module.
	local capHit = #particle.ActiveEmits + (particle._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= (particle.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000)
	if capHit and cfg.EmitTarget and not Events._capSkipWarned then
		Events._capSkipWarned = true
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles Events] active-particle cap reached; event EmitTargets are being skipped")
	end

	if cfg.EmitTarget and not capHit then
		Events.emitTargetInstance(particle, cfg.EmitTarget, cfg.EmitMode, payload, pData, chainCtx, depthLimit)
	end

	if cfg.Module then
		local fn = Events.compile(cfg.Module)
		if fn then
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, err = xpcall(fn, debug.traceback, payload)
				if not ok then Events.reportScriptError(cfg.Module, err) end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Mixins: EmitTarget (emitTargetInstance / _emitTransformed) and Hit (afterUpdate).
require(script.EmitTarget)(Events)
require(script.Hit)(Events)

return Events
